clips.extras: four small clan children in little hide tunics with fur hoods, covered from shoulders to knees, crowd around the hearth holding out their hands in soft focus
clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling, a chocolate bar snapping into pieces, the crinkle of a plain wrapper, children's soft giggles and munching, wind sighing at the cave mouth

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of @Pebble chewing with wide eyes in the firelight, handheld
50mm medium shot of @Leo kneeling by the hearth, snapping a chocolate bar into small squares for the clan children, slow push-in
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Pebble onto @Leo, locked off
100mm extreme close-up of @Pebble licking melted chocolate off his fingertips, locked off

steps: @Pebble sits cross-legged by the hearth with a square of chocolate bulging in his cheek and is already speaking fast through a full mouth.
@Pebble keeps talking with his mouth full, his big dark eyes stretched wide, one sticky hand pressed to his cheek.
@Pebble holds the little brown square up to the firelight and stares at it in wonder as he goes on talking.
@Pebble asks his question fast, leaning toward the hearth with his eyebrows high and his cheeks bulging.
@Pebble finishes and closes his mouth, chewing, as @Leo kneels by the hearth and starts answering at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking as he peels back the plain crinkled wrapper of the last chocolate bar with a wistful smile.
@Leo snaps the bar into small squares as he goes on, nodding far off toward the dark cave mouth.
@Leo puts a square into each small reaching hand of the clan children around him, still talking warmly.
@Leo holds up the very last piece between two fingers and shows it to @Pebble as he keeps talking.
@Leo drops the last piece into @Pebble's palm and folds the small fingers over it, still speaking.
@Leo nods at the other children gathered behind the boy as he keeps talking, his eyebrows raised kindly.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, smiling, as @Pebble breaks his piece in half for a smaller child beside him.
@Pebble licks a smear of melted chocolate from his fingertip, mouth closed around it, eyes huge in the firelight.
@Pebble pulls his finger out with a tiny pop and stares at it in wonder, lips pressed together.
@Pebble licks the next fingertip with his eyes rolling up in delight, the firelight flickering on his cold-pink cheeks, silent.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: One blanket, two people. Back to back. Purely for warmth. Strictly professional.
turns.tone: brisk and businesslike, hiding a blush

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Can I ask why you're quitting? The real reason.
turns.tone: quiet and careful, honest for once

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Because you never needed me. You needed someone holding the lighter.
turns.tone: slow and low after a pause, a little hurt

clips.setting: Night inside the large Ice Age clan cave: the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, bare rock walls with no handprints, a hearth fire glowing red, sleeping beds of dry grass and furs, hides on poles, deep shadows beyond the firelight.

clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling close by, the crinkle of a foil blanket, wind moaning softly at the cave mouth, slow sleeping breaths from the dark, an ember popping

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo sitting back to back under one silver blanket near the hearth, @Mia facing the lens, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo on the other side, looking away into the dark half of the cave, slow push-in
100mm extreme close-up of @Mia's face in the firelight, her eyes lowered, locked off
24mm wide shot of the firelit cave with @Mia and @Leo back to back under the silver blanket near the hearth, locked off

steps: @Mia sits back to back with @Leo under one crinkling silver blanket near the hearth and is already speaking at an even, businesslike pace.
@Mia keeps talking, tugging her half of the silver blanket up to her chin, her eyes fixed straight ahead.
@Mia holds up one finger without turning round as she lays down the rules, cheeks pink in the firelight.
@Mia keeps talking evenly, her gaze locked on the bare rock wall, while @Leo's back stays pressed against hers.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, pressing her lips tight, the firelight warm on her flushed cheeks.
On the other side, @Leo stares into the dark half of the cave and starts speaking slowly and quietly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, turning his head a little toward his shoulder without looking round.
@Leo swallows between phrases and goes on softly, his fingers fidgeting with the edge of the silver blanket.
@Leo finishes the question and closes his mouth, holding very still against her back.
@Mia's eyes drop to her hands in her lap, and after a breath she starts answering slowly and quietly.
@Mia keeps speaking softly, her green eyes glistening in the firelight, her jaw tight.
@Mia mimes flicking a lighter with her thumb in her lap as she goes on in a low voice.
@Mia says the last words almost in a whisper, her shoulders sinking back against @Leo's back.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, blinking hard, as the hearth fire crackles beside them.
Back to back under the one silver blanket, @Mia and @Leo sit very still looking in opposite directions, both silent.

scenes.title: Day Three: The Fire Dies (Ngày 3: Lửa chết)
scenes.time_label: Đêm bão tuyết đến rạng sáng (08:00–09:00)
scenes.location: Đêm bão tuyết trong hang của bộ lạc: gió thốc tuyết qua cửa hang, bếp lửa chỉ còn tro xám ướt với một sợi khói mỏng, măng đá hình voi ma mút, vách đá trơn, mọi người co ro trên ổ cỏ và lông thú.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng sâu trong hang nhìn ra cửa hang: bếp lửa tắt ở giữa, cửa hang vòm với tuyết thốc vào ở xa nhất, góc của hai người lạ bên phải, ổ lông thú của quần chúng bên trái; ở 09.3–09.4 máy quay thấp dưới mái đá khô, tấm đá phẳng ở giữa khung, bếp lửa nguội ở xa phía sau.
scenes.props: Que bới tro, sừng lửa rỗng trong tay Pebble, ngọn giáo dựng đứng của Roar, bộ khoan cung (cung bằng cành uốn và dây giày của Leo, que khoan, nắp đá, tấm gỗ đế có khía), bùi nhùi xơ vỏ bạch dương, củi bạch dương khô, đốm than đỏ.
scenes.setting: A blizzard night inside the large Ice Age clan cave: wind drives snow in through the wide arched mouth, the hearth is only cold grey ash with a thin thread of smoke, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, bare rock walls, people huddled under furs on beds of dry grass.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: You slept, little one. The fire is dead.
turns.tone: grave and quiet, without anger

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: I closed my eyes for one breath! Only one breath, Grandmother!
turns.tone: fast and tearful, pleading

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Our fire-maker went to the stars last winter. No fire, the white eats us.
turns.tone: slow and heavy, a quiet grief

wardrobe.@Moon: a long reindeer-hide cloak with a grey fur collar over a knee-length sewn hide tunic, a necklace of pierced sea shells, empty-handed with no horn, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: a howling blizzard wind driving snow through the cave mouth, a stick scraping through cold ash, a boy sniffling, furs rustling in the dark

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Moon kneeling at the cold grey hearth, stirring the ash with a stick as snow blows in, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Pebble hugging the empty fire horn, his lip trembling, handheld
50mm medium two-shot of @Moon looking up at @Pebble across the dead hearth, locked off
85mm close-up of @Moon's lined face with snow drifting behind her, slow push-in

steps: @Moon kneels at the hearth, stirs the cold grey ash with a stick, and is already speaking slowly in a low, heavy voice.
@Moon keeps talking slowly as she turns over the wet ash; not a single ember glows beneath it.
Snow blows in through the wide cave mouth behind her as @Moon goes on, her eyes on the dead hearth.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, laying the stick down across the ash, her shoulders heavy.
@Pebble stands beside the hearth hugging the empty hollow fire horn and starts speaking fast, his voice wobbling.
@Pebble keeps talking quickly, his chin trembling, the empty horn clutched tight against his chest.
@Pebble holds up one small finger toward @Moon as he goes on pleading, his eyes brimming.
@Pebble finishes and closes his mouth, ducking his head so low that his messy hair falls over his eyes.
@Moon looks up at @Pebble across the dead hearth and starts speaking slowly, her pale eyes steady.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, turning her gaze up toward the dark roof of the cave.
@Moon goes on in the same low voice, rubbing a pinch of cold ash between her fingers.
@Moon glances at the snow driving in through the cave mouth as she keeps speaking.
@Moon's lined face is lit only by grey storm light as she keeps talking, snowflakes drifting behind her.
@Moon says the last words very slowly, her breath clouding white in the cold.
@Moon finishes, closes her mouth and lowers her eyes to the cold ash, while snow keeps blowing past behind her.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Since the strangers came, the big cat walks close, and tonight the fire dies! Throw them into the white!
turns.tone: roaring, fast and furious

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Wait. Please, give us until dawn. We'll bring your fire back. I promise.
turns.tone: steady and upright, calm under pressure

wardrobe.@Mia: a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.extras: clan members wrapped in furs on beds of dry grass, covered from shoulders to knees, sit up and watch from the shadows in soft focus
clips.sfx: blizzard wind howling through the cave mouth, snow hissing on cold stones, an uneasy rustle of furs across the cave, a leather thong creaking on a spear shaft

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Roar rising from his furs beside the dead hearth with his spear upright in his fist, handheld
85mm close-up of @Roar roaring with snow driving in behind him, handheld
24mm wide shot across the dark cave as clan members sit up under their furs and @Mia steps out of the far corner into the middle, slow pan
85mm close-up of @Mia standing straight with her chin up, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Mia onto @Roar with his spear upright, locked off

steps: @Roar surges up from his furs beside the dead hearth, his long spear held upright in one fist, and is already shouting fast.
@Roar keeps shouting, turning toward the dark far corner of the cave, his heavy brows drawn down hard.
@Roar flings his free arm toward the snow swirling in through the cave mouth as he shouts on.
Snow drives in behind @Roar as he keeps roaring, the spear upright beside him and the teeth on his necklace rattling.
@Roar's breath steams in the freezing air as he bellows on, his jaw thrust forward.
@Roar sweeps his free arm toward the howling white beyond the cave mouth as he shouts the last words.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, chest heaving, as @Mia steps out of the dark corner and starts speaking at an even pace.
Clan members sit up under their furs and stare as @Mia walks into the middle of the cave, still talking calmly.
@Mia stops beside the cold hearth, holds up both open palms toward @Roar and keeps talking steadily.
@Mia stands very straight, chin up, her green eyes level, and goes on speaking firmly.
@Mia presses one hand flat over her heart as she says the last words, never looking away.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, standing her ground, her breath fogging in the cold.
@Roar glares at @Mia over the dead hearth with his mouth closed, his spear upright in his fist.
@Mia holds his stare without blinking, mouth closed, while snow swirls in past the cave mouth.
@Roar slowly lowers his chin, silent, his knuckles pale on the upright spear shaft, still watching her.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Bow drill. I know how, but I'm not strong enough. Long, steady strokes. Press down. Don't stop when it smokes.
turns.tone: focused and practical, teaching as she works

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Then I'll be the arms. You be the brains.
turns.tone: fast and determined, a lopsided grin

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Keep going, Leo.
turns.tone: slow and soft, quietly urging him on

clips.setting: Blue pre-dawn light in a dry corner of the Ice Age clan cave under a low rock overhang: a flat stone work area, dry birch wood, a pile of fluffy birch-bark tinder, the cold dead hearth visible behind, snow easing outside the mouth.

wardrobe.@Leo: a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket over a grey fleece, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: a bowstring creaking, a wooden spindle squeaking and whirring in a notch, the blizzard dying away to soft gusts outside, ragged breathing, snow sliding off the rock overhang

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of @Mia kneeling on the flat stone under the low overhang, laying out a bow drill, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia straining at the bow, her face tight with effort, handheld
35mm medium two-shot of @Leo kneeling beside @Mia and taking the bow from her hands, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia looking up at @Leo, locked off
100mm extreme close-up of the spindle whirring in the notched board as the bow saws back and forth, locked off

steps: @Mia kneels on the flat stone under the low overhang, laying out a bent bow, a spindle and a notched board, already speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking as she ties @Leo's bootlace tight across the bent branch to string the bow.
@Mia twists the spindle into the bootlace and sets its tip in the notch of the board, still explaining.
@Mia tucks a fluffy nest of birch-bark tinder under the notch as she goes on talking evenly.
@Mia presses a small stone cap on top of the spindle and starts sawing the bow, still talking.
@Mia's arms shake as she saws the bow back and forth, her face tight with effort, words coming between breaths.
The spindle wobbles and slips out of the notch as @Mia keeps talking, her hands trembling with cold.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, letting the bow sag, her breath ragged and white.
@Leo kneels beside her, gently takes the bow out of her trembling hands and starts speaking fast.
@Leo keeps talking quickly as he plants his boot on the board and fits the spindle back into the notch.
@Leo finishes with a lopsided grin, closes his mouth and sets the bowstring against the spindle.
@Mia sets his left hand on the stone cap above the spindle, looks him in the eye and starts speaking slowly.
@Mia says the last words softly, her hand resting on his shoulder, then closes her mouth.
In extreme close-up the spindle whirs in the notch as the bow saws back and forth in long steady strokes, silent.
A first thin wisp of grey smoke curls up from the blackened notch as the bow keeps moving, both of them silent.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: There! An ember! Mia, there's an ember! Don't breathe too hard!
turns.tone: breathless and shaky, hardly daring to breathe

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Gently... gently... There it is. Your first fire.
turns.tone: a slow soft whisper between gentle breaths

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Our first fire. I couldn't have done it without your hands on mine.
turns.tone: slow and choked up, voice catching

clips.setting: Blue pre-dawn light in a dry corner of the Ice Age clan cave under a low rock overhang: a flat stone work area, dry birch wood, a pile of fluffy birch-bark tinder, the cold dead hearth visible behind, snow easing outside the mouth.

steps: @Leo, with @Mia's hands resting on his on the bow drill, freezes as a red ember glows in the notch and is already speaking fast.
@Leo keeps talking fast, staring down at the tiny ember, his blistered palms frozen on the bow and the stone cap.
@Leo holds his breath between words and keeps talking in a shaky whisper, eyes locked on the glowing ember.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as @Mia tips the ember gently from the notch into a fluffy nest of birch-bark tinder.
@Mia lifts the tinder nest with @Leo's blistered hands cupped under hers and starts whispering slowly between soft breaths.
@Mia blows gently into the smoking nest and keeps whispering, her face lit faint orange from below.
A small flame flickers up from the tinder between their four hands as @Mia whispers the last words, eyes shining.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth as @Leo looks up from the little flame to her face and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, his voice catching, the small flame dancing between their cupped hands.
@Leo looks down at her hands resting over his raw blistered fingers as he goes on.
@Leo's grey-blue eyes glisten in the firelight as he keeps speaking softly, holding her gaze.
Together they lower the burning nest into a little pile of dry birch wood as @Leo keeps talking.
@Leo says the last words quietly, his eyes still on hers across the growing flames.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, swallowing hard, as the dry birch wood catches with a soft crackle.
@Leo and @Mia kneel face to face, looking at each other across the small new fire, both silent, warm light on their faces.

scenes.title: Day Four: Cold Sickness (Ngày 4: Hạ thân nhiệt)
scenes.location: Ban ngày trong hang của bộ lạc: ánh sáng dịu qua cửa hang vòm, măng đá hình voi ma mút, vách đá trơn, bếp lửa cháy đỏ ở giữa, ổ cỏ và lông thú.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: You brought back our fire. From today, the clan calls you Fire. And the woman with the clever hands, Spark.
turns.tone: slow and solemn, a quiet ceremony

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Thank you, Grandmother. But she taught me everything. I just didn't quit.
turns.tone: humble and moved, head bowed

steps: @Moon stands before the red hearth with a folded reindeer-hide cape across her arms and is already speaking slowly to @Leo.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly, her pale eyes on @Leo, who stands in his dusty red jacket with both hands wrapped in white bandage strips.
@Moon lifts the cape and shakes it open, its grey fur collar catching the firelight, as she goes on.
@Moon steps closer to @Leo as she keeps talking, holding the open cape up in both hands.
Around the hearth the seated clan watches as @Moon drapes the reindeer-hide cape over @Leo's shoulders, still speaking slowly.
@Moon smooths the fur collar flat on @Leo's shoulders with her weathered hands as she goes on.
@Moon turns her head and nods toward the far side of the hearth, beyond the edge of frame, as she keeps talking.
@Moon's lined face softens as she says the last words, the red-ochre dot bright on her forehead.
@Moon finishes, closes her mouth and steps back, her hands folded in front of her shell necklace.
@Leo bows his head low under the heavy cape and starts speaking at an even pace, his voice thick.
@Leo keeps talking, glancing off past the edge of frame toward the far side of the hearth.
@Leo touches his bandaged hands to his chest as he goes on, his eyes lowered.
@Leo lifts his eyes to @Moon with a small crooked smile as he says the last words.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, pulling the warm fur collar closer with his bandaged fingers.
In extreme close-up @Leo's bandaged fingers rest on the grey fur collar of the cape as firelight flickers over them, silent.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Spark! The ice broke! Your legs are all wet! But the fire horn is safe, look, it's still safe!
turns.tone: high and frantic, words tumbling out

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: G-good. Good. I'm f-fine, really. Let's just... walk back home. Slowly.
turns.tone: shaky through chattering teeth, playing it down

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: thin ice cracking and splintering, a splash of icy water, ice chunks knocking together, a boy's fast breathing, teeth chattering, wet boots squelching in snow

85mm close-up of @Pebble on the bank shouting with his hands clutching his fur hood, handheld
50mm medium shot of @Mia wading out of the broken edge ice onto the bank, shaking hard, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia's pale face and blue lips under the cream beanie, locked off

steps: The thin edge ice cracks under @Mia's boots and she drops knee-deep into the icy stream, the fire horn held high, as @Pebble on the bank is already shouting.
@Pebble keeps shouting fast from the snowy bank, both hands clutching his fur hood, his eyes huge.
@Mia stands knee-deep among floating ice chunks, gasping, the hollow fire horn safe above her head, while @Pebble shouts on.
@Pebble points at her soaked dark trousers as he keeps shouting, hopping from foot to foot on the bank.
@Pebble reaches out his arms as @Mia passes the dry fire horn up to him, still shouting.
@Pebble hugs the fire horn to his chest and holds it up to show her, shouting the last words.
@Pebble finishes and closes his mouth as @Mia starts speaking through chattering teeth and wades out onto the bank.
@Mia keeps talking in a shaky voice, icy water streaming from her soaked trousers, her whole body shaking hard.
@Mia waves one trembling hand at @Pebble as she keeps talking, trying to smile with blue lips.
@Mia wraps her arms tight around herself under the hide cape as she goes on, teeth chattering.
@Mia takes one stumbling step along the bank, still talking shakily, her wet boots squelching in the snow.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, her jaw shaking, her face pale under the cream beanie.
@Mia sways on her feet with her mouth closed, shivering hard, frost already forming on her wet trousers.
@Pebble takes @Mia's icy hand in his and tugs her toward the cave, the fire horn under his other arm, both silent.
@Pebble leads @Mia slowly along the snowy bank toward the cliffs, her wet legs stiff and stumbling, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: You're stumbling, mumbling, fumbling. You taught me this. Hypothermia. Wet socks off, now.
turns.tone: fast and worried, holding it together

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: I'm just... grumbling. That's the fourth one.
turns.tone: slow, thick and drowsy, a weak joke

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Then you've got all four. Dry socks. Furs. Silver skin. And I'm not leaving.
turns.tone: steady and firm, a quiet promise

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers soaked dark to the knees, wet grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of @Leo kneeling in front of @Mia by the red hearth, working at her wet bootlaces, handheld
85mm close-up of @Mia shivering with her eyelids heavy, locked off

steps: @Leo kneels in front of @Mia by the red hearth, watching her numb fingers fumble at her wet bootlaces, and is already talking fast.
@Leo keeps talking quickly, gently moving her clumsy hands aside and pulling the frozen laces loose himself.
@Leo eases off one wet grey boot and then the other as he goes on, his voice tight.
@Leo peels off her soaked socks and sets them by the fire, still talking, his eyes on her pale face.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as @Mia, swaying where she sits, starts speaking slowly in a thick, drowsy voice.
@Mia keeps talking slowly and drowsily, her eyelids heavy, a crooked little smile on her pale lips.
@Mia lifts one shaking finger as if counting, her words thick and clumsy as she goes on.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, her finger drooping, her whole body shivering under the hide cape.
@Leo pulls a pair of dry grey wool socks from inside his jacket, warm from his body, and starts speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking as he pulls the dry socks onto her cold feet, one after the other.
@Leo tucks a thick reindeer fur around her legs and shoulders, over her clothes, as he goes on.
@Leo shakes out the crinkling silver blanket and wraps it over the furs around her, still talking.
@Leo kneels close in front of her, both bandaged hands on her shoulders, and says the last words firmly.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, rubbing her arms briskly through the furs and the silver blanket.
@Mia sits wrapped in furs and the silver blanket beside the hearth, mouth closed, as @Leo stays kneeling right in front of her.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Please. Don't film this. Don't turn me into a video.
turns.tone: weak and small, barely above a whisper

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Camera's off. It's just me now. Drink. Hot stones, a hide bag, melted snow. Like you taught me.
turns.tone: slow and gentle, plain and honest

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: You were actually listening.
turns.tone: a faint teasing smile in a tired voice

steps: @Mia sits wrapped in thick furs and the crinkled silver blanket by the fire, staring at the small chest camera on @Leo's harness, already speaking weakly.
@Mia keeps talking slowly in a thin voice, her eyes on the tiny glowing light of the camera.
@Mia pulls the silver blanket tighter around her face with a shaking hand as she goes on.
@Mia's eyes lift from the camera to @Leo's face as she says the last words, barely above a whisper.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth as @Leo presses the button on his chest camera, its little light goes dark, and he starts speaking.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, tilting the dark little lens down toward the floor so she can see it is off.
@Leo leans closer to her in the firelight as he goes on, his voice low and plain.
@Leo presses a wooden cup of steaming water into her shaking hands as he keeps speaking.
@Leo lifts a glowing red stone out of the hearth with two sticks as he goes on talking.
@Leo drops the hot stone into a hide bag of melted snow hanging beside the fire, and it hisses into steam as he keeps talking.
@Leo looks back at @Mia through the rising steam as he keeps speaking, a small smile on his face.
@Leo says the last words softly, nodding at the hide bag and the cup in her hands.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as @Mia, holding the warm cup, starts speaking slowly with a weak smile.
@Mia keeps talking in a tired, teasing voice, her eyes on his face over the rim of the cup.
@Mia finishes, closes her mouth and takes a slow sip of warm water, the steam curling past her pale cheeks.

scenes.title: Day Five: Spear vs. Fish Trap (Ngày 5: Ngọn giáo và cái lờ)
scenes.location: Cửa hang buổi sáng: thềm đất bằng nơi cả hang tụ họp, măng đá hình voi ma mút phía trên, thung lũng tuyết và con suối băng bên dưới, nắng nhạt.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng trên thềm đất trước cửa hang: cửa hang vòm và măng đá hình voi ma mút phía sau bên trái, thung lũng tuyết và con suối băng ở phía dưới bên phải; ở 11.2 và 11.4 máy quay thấp trên mặt vũng băng, các lỗ băng ở giữa khung, bụi liễu trên bờ phía sau.
scenes.props: Ống phóng giáo bằng gỗ và ngọn giáo dài dựng đứng của Roar, cái lờ hình phễu đan bằng cành liễu, bó cành liễu, các lỗ băng, cá bạc còn sống quẫy trong lờ, sừng lửa của Grandma Moon, áo choàng da của Leo và Mia, băng vải trên tay Leo.
scenes.setting: Morning at the wide arched mouth of the Ice Age clan cave: the mammoth-shaped stalagmite inside, a flat earthen terrace where the clan gathers, the snowy valley and the icy stream below, pale sunlight.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Fire-maker, can you feed us too? Before high sun, I bring meat. What do you bring? Nothing, like always.
turns.tone: mocking and fast, a challenge

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: We'll bring enough for everyone. For you too. You'll see.
turns.tone: trying to sound sure, a little too loud

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: We will see.
turns.tone: slow and low, a grim promise

steps: @Roar stands in the middle of the earthen terrace, twirling a wooden spear-thrower in one hand, his long spear upright in the other, already talking fast.
@Roar keeps talking quickly, stepping up close to @Leo, the spear-thrower spinning between his fingers.
@Roar jerks his chin at the pale sun over the valley as he goes on, his eyebrows drawn down.
@Roar thumps his own broad chest with the spear-thrower as he keeps boasting, the spear upright beside him.
@Roar leans down toward @Leo with a deep scowl as he keeps talking fast, the spear still upright at his side.
@Roar flicks two fingers at the empty air in front of @Leo's chest as he goes on with a sneer.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, his lip curled, the spear-thrower still in his fist.
@Leo folds his arms across his chest, lifts his chin and starts speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking, holding his voice level although his eyes flick up at @Roar towering over him.
@Leo nods toward the frozen stream far below as he goes on, his folded arms held tight.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, holding his chin up a little too high.
@Roar narrows his eyes and starts speaking slowly, turning the spear-thrower over in his hand.
@Roar finishes the words and closes his mouth, then turns his back on @Leo.
@Roar strides away across the terrace with his spear upright, while @Leo stands alone with his arms folded, mouth closed.
@Leo lets out a long breath and unfolds his arms, his shoulders dropping, silent.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: It's a willow trap. Wide mouth, narrow neck. Easy to swim in, impossible to find the way out.
turns.tone: practical, a teacher showing her trick

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Sounds like me. With you.
turns.tone: soft and slow, looking right at her

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Hold the branches tighter, Romeo. And stop flirting with the fish.
turns.tone: quick and flustered, cheeks burning

steps: @Mia kneels on the thick clear ice beside a hole, weaving long willow branches into a funnel, and is already speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking as she bends the willow branches into a wide round mouth, her hide cape over her shoulders.
@Leo, kneeling opposite, holds the loose ends of the branches together while @Mia goes on explaining.
@Mia threads a thin branch in and out to pull the funnel narrow as she keeps talking.
@Mia keeps speaking evenly, her cheeks pink again and her green eyes bright, her fingers quick on the willow.
@Mia pokes a finger through the narrow neck of the trap to show the way in as she goes on.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, tugging the last willow branch tight with both hands.
@Leo, still holding the branch ends, gazes at her face instead of the trap and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking softly, his grey-blue eyes not leaving hers, the branches forgotten in his hands.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as @Mia's cheeks flush red and she starts answering fast, eyes on the trap.
@Mia keeps talking quickly, pushing the branch ends firmly back into his slack hands without looking at him.
@Mia jerks her chin at the dark water in the ice hole as she goes on, biting back a smile.
@Mia says the last words with a quick sideways glance at him, the corner of her mouth twitching.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, pressing her lips together to hide a smile, her cheeks still red.
@Leo grins and holds the branches tighter, both silent, kneeling together beside the round hole in the ice.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: The reindeer went over the ridge. The wind carried my smell to them. Nothing today.
turns.tone: low and grudging, head bowed

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Empty hands are no shame for a hunter. A proud mouth is.
turns.tone: slow and even, a gentle rebuke

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: And the strangers? Where are they?
turns.tone: sharp and fast, suspicion flaring

steps: @Roar walks up onto the sun-glared terrace with his spear upright and his other hand empty, and is already speaking with his head lowered.
@Roar keeps talking as he stops in front of @Moon, while the silent clan watches from the terrace.
@Roar points back over the bright snowy ridge with his free hand as he goes on, his jaw tight.
@Roar keeps his eyes on the snow at his feet as he keeps talking, sweat shining on his brow.
@Roar opens his empty free hand toward @Moon as he goes on, his voice dropping low.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, his heavy brows drawn down, the spear still upright beside him.
@Moon looks at him with calm pale eyes and starts speaking slowly, the fire horn at her hip.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, laying one weathered hand on @Roar's empty palm.
@Moon lifts her chin as she goes on, each word clear and heavy in the noon glare.
@Moon touches two fingers to her own lips as she keeps speaking, her gaze firm on him.
@Moon says the last words slowly, never raising her voice, while the clan stands still behind her.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, letting go of his hand and folding her arms inside her cloak.
@Roar's head comes up sharply and he starts speaking fast, his eyes sweeping across the terrace.
@Roar finishes the question and closes his mouth, scanning the crowd and the snowy slope below, nostrils flaring.
@Roar turns his head, silent, to stare down at the bright empty valley, his knuckles tight on the upright spear.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Look at that! It's full! Mia, it's full! Fish for everyone! Even for the proud mouth!
turns.tone: whooping, fast and breathless with joy

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Told you. You don't need to chase your food. You just need to think like it.
turns.tone: laughing, dry and pleased with herself

steps: @Leo and @Mia heave the dripping willow trap up out of the ice hole together, and @Leo is already shouting fast, eyes wide.
Live silver fish flash and wriggle inside the trap as @Leo keeps shouting, water streaming off the willow.
@Leo lifts the heavy trap higher to show it off as he keeps talking fast, laughing between the words.
@Leo whoops and turns to @Mia, still shouting, his boots slipping a little on the wet ice.
@Leo points the full trap toward the distant cave terrace as he shouts on, grinning hugely.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as his boots skid out on the slick ice, and @Mia catches his arm and starts speaking.
@Mia steadies @Leo by the elbow with one hand, the trap between them, and keeps talking with a laugh in her voice.
@Mia keeps talking at an even pace, nodding at the wriggling silver fish in the trap.
@Mia taps her temple with one finger as she goes on, eyebrows raised, a dry smile on her face.
@Mia wiggles her flat hand through the air like a fish swimming into the trap as she keeps talking.
@Mia says the last words with a little shrug, still holding @Leo's arm firmly.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, and she and @Leo shake with silent laughter, steadying each other on the ice.
@Leo and @Mia lean their heads close together over the full trap, laughing silently, their breath fogging in the sun.
In extreme close-up the live silver fish wriggle and flick their tails inside the dripping willow trap, all silent but the splashing.
@Leo's bandaged hands lower the full trap gently back into the water of the ice hole, the fish still alive and swimming, silent.

scenes.title: Night Five: The Seeing Stone (Đêm 5: Hòn đá biết nhìn)
scenes.location: Đêm trong hang, bếp lửa đỏ rực, cá nướng trên que quanh lửa, măng đá hình voi ma mút, vách đá trơn, ổ cỏ và lông thú, bóng tối sâu ngoài vùng sáng của lửa.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt cạnh bếp lửa trong hang ban đêm: bếp lửa với cá nướng trên que ở giữa, Leo ngồi bên trái, Mia (Pebble ở 12.1) bên phải, cửa hang tối và vách đá trơn ở phía sau.
scenes.props: Camera đeo ngực của Leo (màn hình chỉ phát sáng, luôn quay lưng về phía ống kính), cá nướng trên que quanh bếp, tảng đá phẳng cạnh lửa nơi camera nằm úp, áo choàng da của Leo và Mia, đứa trẻ ngủ dưới tấm lông thú ở hậu cảnh.
scenes.setting: Night inside the large Ice Age clan cave: the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, bare rock walls with no handprints, a hearth fire glowing red, sleeping beds of dry grass and furs, hides on poles, deep shadows beyond the firelight.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: The seeing stone has people inside! Tiny people, and caves of light taller than mountains!
turns.tone: an awed, excited whisper

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: That's my city. Millions of people, and not one of them knows how to catch a fish under ice.
turns.tone: warm and amused, gently proud of the boy

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling, fish sizzling on sticks over the coals, the faint electronic hum of a small camera, wind sighing at the cave mouth, a boy's quick breathing

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of @Pebble with his face pressed close to the glowing back of the small camera, blue light on his round cheeks, slow push-in
50mm medium two-shot of @Leo and @Pebble sitting by the hearth, the small camera between them with its screen turned away from the lens, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo lit from below by the screen glow, slow push-in
24mm wide shot of the firelit cave with fish roasting on sticks around the hearth and @Leo and @Pebble sitting close beside it, locked off

steps: @Pebble kneels by the hearth with his nose almost touching the small camera @Leo holds out, its screen turned away from us, and is already whispering fast.
Cold blue light from the glowing screen flickers over @Pebble's round face as he keeps whispering, eyes huge.
@Pebble reaches one finger toward the glowing screen, then snatches it back, still whispering excitedly.
@Pebble stretches both arms high above his head to show something enormous, whispering on, the blue glow on his face.
@Pebble finishes and closes his mouth, staring into the blue glow without blinking.
@Leo, sitting beside him with the little camera in his bandaged hands, chuckles and starts speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking warmly, tilting the camera so the boy can see better, its screen still turned away from us.
@Leo spreads his free hand wide in the air to show how big the city is as he goes on.
@Leo nods at the fish roasting on sticks around the hearth as he keeps talking with a grin.
@Leo taps @Pebble's chest proudly with one finger as he goes on talking, eyebrows raised.
@Leo keeps speaking, his grin softening as he looks down at the glowing camera in his hands.
@Leo says the last words quietly, the blue glow lighting his bearded face from below.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, smiling at the boy, the screen glow fading on his beard.
@Pebble leans his head against @Leo's arm, still staring at the glow, both mouths closed.
The fire crackles around the roasting fish as @Leo and @Pebble sit close together in the soft blue glow, silent.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Battery's almost dead. Seven days of footage to shoot, and it's dying on day five. Typical.
turns.tone: wry and resigned, a tired joke

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then talk to me instead of it. I'm not a lens, but I've got better eyes.
turns.tone: soft and teasing, head tilted

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.extras: a small clan child in a hide tunic with a fur hood, covered from shoulders to knees, curled up asleep under a fur beside the hearth in soft focus in the background, face hidden
clips.sfx: the faint whine of a small camera fading out, the hearth fire crackling low, a child's slow sleeping breaths, fish skins sizzling on the coals, wind sighing at the cave mouth

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of @Leo walking up to the hearth with the small camera flickering in his bandaged hand, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo frowning down at the dimming camera, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of @Leo sitting down beside @Mia by the fire, a sleeping child in soft focus behind them, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia with @Leo's shoulder in the foreground, locked off

steps: @Leo walks toward the hearth holding the small chest camera, its screen glow flickering on his face, and is already speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking, frowning as the camera's glow flickers on and off in his bandaged hand.
@Leo gives the little camera a gentle shake as he goes on, sighing through his words.
@Leo stares down at the dimming glow as he keeps talking, his mouth twisting wryly.
@Leo holds the dying camera up at eye level and shakes his head as he goes on talking.
The glow on @Leo's face fades out as he says the last words with a dry little laugh.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, sitting down beside @Mia at the fire, as she tilts her head and starts speaking.
@Mia keeps talking at an even pace, her head tilted, a warm half-smile in the firelight.
@Mia gently pushes the dark camera down into his lap with two fingers as she goes on.
@Mia points two fingers at her own green eyes as she keeps talking, eyebrows raised.
@Mia turns her shoulder toward him, firelight on her face, still speaking softly.
@Mia holds his gaze as she says the last words, her half-smile steady.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, waiting, her head still tilted toward him.
@Mia watches with her mouth closed as @Leo clips the dark camera back onto his chest harness.
Behind them a small child sleeps curled under a fur by the hearth in soft focus, while @Mia keeps her eyes on @Leo, silent.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Three years I faked everything. The fires, the fear, the food. The only real thing on my channel was you.
turns.tone: slow and raw, a hard confession

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then turn it off, Leo. Please. Turn the camera off for good.
turns.tone: trembling and teary, a soft plea

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling and settling, a twig catching with a tiny hiss, wind sighing at the cave mouth, slow breathing, embers ticking

shots.camera: 85mm close-up of @Leo staring into the fire, firelight moving on his face, slow push-in
35mm medium two-shot of @Leo turning from the fire to look at @Mia beside him, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia with her eyes welling up, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo onto @Mia, locked off

steps: @Leo sits beside @Mia at the fire, staring deep into the flames, and is already speaking slowly and quietly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, the firelight flickering over his bearded face, his eyes never leaving the flames.
@Leo turns a twig over in his bandaged fingers as he goes on, his voice low.
@Leo drops the twig into the fire and watches it catch as he keeps speaking softly.
@Leo pauses, swallows, then goes on slowly, his jaw tight in the orange light.
@Leo slowly turns his head away from the fire toward @Mia as he keeps talking.
@Leo looks straight into @Mia's eyes as he goes on, his voice dropping even lower.
@Leo says the last words very softly, holding her gaze, his chest rising with a deep breath.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as @Mia's green eyes fill with tears and she starts speaking.
@Mia keeps talking at an even pace, her voice trembling, a tear shining on her lashes.
@Mia glances down at the small camera on his chest harness as she goes on, then back up at his face.
@Mia lays her fingers lightly on the little camera as she keeps speaking, her voice breaking.
@Mia says the last words in a near whisper, a tear sliding down her freckled cheek.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, her fingers still resting on the little camera on his chest.
@Leo looks down at her hand on the camera, then back up into her eyes, both silent in the firelight.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: It's off. No battery, no audience, no comments. Just us and the fire.
turns.tone: a slow soft whisper, very close

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Just us. Honestly, that's more terrifying than the lion.
turns.tone: a whisper with a shaky little laugh

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Of course it beeps right now. Even my camera's jealous.
turns.tone: bursting into laughter, quick and rueful

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling softly, a small plastic click, two quick electronic beeps from a camera, soft shared laughter, wind sighing at the cave mouth

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of @Leo unclipping the small camera from his chest harness beside @Mia, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo whispering in the firelight, slow push-in
35mm medium two-shot of @Leo and @Mia leaning in until their foreheads almost touch, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Leo laughing as he talks, handheld
24mm wide shot of @Leo and @Mia leaning shoulder to shoulder by the fire, the camera face down on a flat rock beside them, locked off

steps: @Leo unclips the small camera from his chest harness, holds down its button until the faint light dies, and is already whispering slowly.
@Leo keeps whispering as he turns the dark camera over in his bandaged hands to show her it is off.
@Leo lays the camera face down on a flat rock beside the fire as he goes on whispering.
@Leo turns back to @Mia, firelight on his face, and keeps whispering slowly, very close to her.
@Leo glances at the dark cave around them, then back into her eyes, still whispering softly.
@Leo finishes the whisper and closes his mouth, his face only inches from hers.
@Mia leans in a little closer and starts whispering back at an even pace, her eyes on his.
@Mia keeps whispering, a small shaky smile tugging at her lips, as their faces drift closer.
@Mia whispers the last words as their foreheads come so close they almost touch, eyes half closed.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, the face-down camera on the rock beeps twice, and @Leo jerks back and starts speaking fast with a laugh.
@Leo keeps talking fast through his laughter, pointing at the face-down camera on the rock.
@Leo shakes his head at the little camera as he goes on, grinning, while @Mia laughs silently with her lips pressed together.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, still laughing silently, as @Mia leans her shoulder against his.
@Leo and @Mia lean shoulder to shoulder by the fire, shaking with silent laughter, her head tipped against his arm.
The two of them sit close together in the warm firelight, shoulders touching, the dark camera face down on the rock beside them, silent.

scenes.title: Day Six: Roar Doesn't Return (Ngày 6: Roar không về)
scenes.location: Cửa hang thời băng hà buổi sáng sương mù: thềm đất trước hang, măng đá hình voi ma mút mờ trong sương, thung lũng tuyết chìm trong sương trắng đục, ổ nằm bằng lông thú trống trơn bên cửa hang.
scenes.axis: Ở 13.1 máy quay đứng sâu trong hang nhìn ra cửa hang: ổ lông thú trống bên trái, màn sương trắng phủ thung lũng ngoài cửa hang ở xa; ở 13.2–13.3 máy quay đứng trên dốc rừng thông, dãy dấu chân chạy từ trái sang phải xuống dốc, các tảng đá xám ở phía dưới bên phải; ở 13.4 máy quay luân phiên nhìn từ miệng hố xuống đáy hố và từ đáy hố lên miệng hố, cây thông to ở bên trái miệng hố.
scenes.props: Ổ lông thú trống trơn, sừng lửa của Grandma Moon, áo choàng da và túi cứu thương đỏ của Mia, dãy dấu chân dài trên tuyết, cành thông gãy và vệt tuyết vừa rơi khỏi cành, cái còi bạc nhỏ đeo dây của Mia, ngọn giáo của Roar gãy đôi dưới đáy hố, camera đeo ngực của Leo.
scenes.setting: Early misty morning at the mouth of the Ice Age clan cave: thick white mist over the snowy valley below, cool grey-blue light, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite faint inside, an empty bed of furs just inside the entrance.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: His bed is cold. He went alone, before light, after the woolly horn-beast. To show the clan he is still first.
turns.tone: slow and heavy, quiet worry under the calm

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Alone, with one spear? Then he's in trouble. We'll find him.
turns.tone: decisive and steady, already moving

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: a cold dawn wind sighing across the cave mouth, water dripping from the rock, the soft rustle of empty furs, pierced shells clicking on a necklace, a distant crow calling in the mist

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Moon kneeling beside the empty bed of furs just inside the misty cave mouth, her palm on the furs, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Moon's deeply lined face turned toward the thick white mist, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Mia onto @Moon beside the empty furs, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia knotting the tie of her hide cape at her collar, her eyes on the mist, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Mia stepping out of the cave mouth toward the white mist with @Moon kneeling by the empty furs behind her, locked off

steps: @Moon kneels beside the empty bed of furs just inside the misty cave mouth, lays her palm flat on it and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly in her low husky voice, pressing her weathered palm into the cold, flattened furs.
@Moon lifts her hand and rubs her cold fingertips together as she goes on, her brow deeply lined.
@Moon turns her pale eyes toward the thick white mist hanging over the valley as she keeps speaking.
@Moon points one gnarled finger out into the grey mist toward the hidden slopes as she goes on slowly.
@Moon keeps speaking, her gaze fixed on the mist, her shell necklace clicking softly with each breath.
@Moon lowers her hand and goes on in the same heavy voice, her jaw tight, the fire horn at her hip.
@Moon slowly shakes her head as she keeps talking, her thick white braid shifting on her reindeer-hide cloak.
@Moon says the last words very slowly, her pale eyes still searching the white mist below the cave.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, while @Mia, standing beside her, pulls her hide cape tight around her shoulders.
@Mia knots the leather tie of her cape at her collar and starts speaking at an even pace, her jaw set.
@Mia keeps talking, giving the red first-aid pouch on her belt a quick pat, her green eyes on the mist.
@Mia turns to @Moon as she goes on, her voice low and firm, one hand resting on the old woman's shoulder.
@Mia says the last words with a short decisive nod, then steps out of the cave mouth toward the mist.
@Mia stands at the edge of the misty terrace with her mouth closed, while @Moon watches her from beside the empty furs.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Fresh tracks, long strides. He was running. See the broken twig, the snow knocked off the branch? This way, quickly.
turns.tone: a focused tracker's voice, quick and sure

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: You read snow like a book. Seriously, is there anything you can't do?
turns.tone: fast and openly admiring, a little awed

clips.setting: A snowy pine forest on the valley slope in the Ice Age, morning: deep fresh snow with a line of long-striding footprints, broken twigs, snow knocked off low branches, scattered grey boulders down the slope, shafts of cold sunlight through the trees.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: boots crunching in deep powder snow, a pine branch creaking, the soft hush of snow sliding off a bough, quiet breathing, a far-off bird call in the pine forest

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot of @Mia kneeling beside a line of long footprints in the deep snow of the pine forest with @Leo standing behind her, slow push-in
100mm extreme close-up of @Mia's finger pointing at a freshly broken twig on a low pine branch, her face in soft focus behind it, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Mia rising to a crouch and pointing down the slope along the tracks, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo gazing at her with a wide admiring grin, slow push-in
35mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo setting off down the slope along the tracks between the pines, handheld follow

steps: @Mia kneels in the deep fresh snow beside a line of long-striding footprints and is already speaking at an even pace, one bare hand over a print.
@Mia keeps talking, spreading her fingers to measure the long gap between two footprints in the snow.
@Mia traces the deep dent at the front of a print with one finger as she goes on, her eyes narrowed.
@Mia points at a freshly broken twig hanging from a low pine branch as she keeps talking.
@Mia's finger moves to a bare patch on the branch where the snow has been knocked off, and she goes on talking.
@Mia rises into a crouch and points down the slope along the line of footprints as she keeps talking.
@Mia glances back over her shoulder at @Leo and says the last words briskly, already moving.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, brushing snow from her knees, as @Leo bends low to follow her pointing hand.
@Leo straightens up, looks at @Mia instead of the tracks and starts speaking fast with a wide grin.
@Leo keeps talking quickly, waving a hand over the footprints as if they were the pages of an open book.
@Leo shakes his head in wonder as he goes on, his grey-blue eyes shining at her.
@Leo asks the last question with his eyebrows high and his palms turned up, then closes his mouth.
@Mia gives a tiny dry shrug, mouth closed, the corner of her lips twitching into a half-smile.
@Mia turns away down the slope following the tracks, and @Leo hurries after her, both mouths closed.
@Mia and @Leo move quickly down the snowy slope between the pines along the footprints, silent, shafts of cold sunlight falling across them.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Three short whistles in a row means help. If he hears it, he'll shout back.
turns.tone: clear and instructive, hushed urgency

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: There! Did you hear that? A voice, down past the rocks! Come on!
turns.tone: sharp and urgent, breathless

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: That's him! Go, go, go!
turns.tone: excited and fast, a burst of relief

clips.setting: A snowy pine forest on the valley slope in the Ice Age, morning: deep fresh snow with a line of long-striding footprints, broken twigs, snow knocked off low branches, scattered grey boulders down the slope, shafts of cold sunlight through the trees.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: three short shrill whistle bursts echoing through the pines, a faint deep shout from far down the slope, boots crunching and sliding in powder snow, quick breathing, snow pattering from branches

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Leo explaining among the snowy pines while @Mia beside him pulls a small silver whistle on a cord from her collar, handheld
100mm extreme close-up of @Mia's face as the small silver whistle meets her lips, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia pointing down the slope past the grey boulders, handheld
50mm medium shot of @Leo shouting with a huge grin, handheld
24mm wide shot of @Mia and @Leo plunging down the snowy slope past the scattered grey boulders, handheld follow

steps: @Leo stands among the snowy pines beside @Mia and is already speaking at an even pace, holding up three fingers.
@Leo keeps talking, tapping each raised finger in turn, while @Mia pulls a small silver whistle on a cord from inside her collar.
@Leo cups a hand behind his ear and nods toward the slope below as he goes on explaining.
@Leo keeps talking, miming a shout with one hand beside his mouth, as @Mia lifts the whistle toward her lips.
@Leo says the last words and gives @Mia a quick nod, his eyes bright, his breath clouding.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and @Mia's whistle blows three short shrill bursts that echo through the snowy pines.
@Mia lowers the whistle and freezes with her head cocked toward a faint distant shout, then starts speaking fast, eyes wide.
@Mia keeps talking quickly, flinging out one arm to point down the slope past the scattered grey boulders.
@Mia takes hold of @Leo's sleeve as she goes on, still pointing, her breath clouding fast in the cold air.
@Mia tugs his sleeve toward the slope as she keeps talking, her boots already turning downhill.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, already turning downhill, as @Leo's face lights up and he starts shouting.
@Leo keeps shouting fast, waving both arms toward the boulders below, a huge grin on his face.
@Leo shouts the last words, closes his mouth and plunges down the slope after @Mia.
@Mia and @Leo run down the snowy slope between the pines, sending up sprays of powder, both mouths closed.
@Mia and @Leo race past the scattered grey boulders down the slope through the shafts of sunlight, silent.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Go away, strangers. I don't need your help. I fell in on purpose. To rest my legs.
turns.tone: gruff and stubborn, hiding the pain

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Sure. Lovely spot for a nap. Very private. We're getting you out anyway, big man.
turns.tone: fast and teasing, grinning down at him

clips.setting: A sinkhole in a snowy pine forest in the Ice Age at midday: a pit about three meters deep with steep walls of earth, rock and tangled roots, snow and collapsed earth at the bottom, a big pine tree right at the edge of the rim, slanting sunlight through the pines.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: loose earth and pebbles trickling down the pit walls, wind moving through the pine tops, a man's heavy breathing below, snow crunching under knees at the rim

shots.camera: 24mm high-angle wide shot looking down into the sinkhole at @Roar sitting at the bottom among snow and collapsed earth, his spear broken in two beside him, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Roar looking up with his jaw set, locked off
35mm low-angle medium shot of @Leo kneeling at the rim of the pit beside the big pine, grinning down, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo at the rim down onto @Roar at the bottom of the pit, locked off

steps: At the bottom of the snowy sinkhole @Roar sits among collapsed earth with his left leg stretched out stiffly and is already speaking in a deep rough growl.
@Roar keeps talking, flapping one big hand up at the rim as if shooing a fly, his jaw clenched.
@Roar folds his arms across his hide tunic as he goes on, trying to look relaxed, a wince crossing his face.
Beside @Roar his long spear lies broken in two on the snow as he keeps growling, his eyes avoiding it.
@Roar lifts his heavy brows and keeps talking with a stubborn scowl, his swollen left ankle stretched out in front of him.
@Roar leans back against the root-tangled earth wall and says the last words as if resting by choice.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth with a curt nod, his chest rising with a sharp breath.
Up at the rim beside the big pine, @Leo kneels in the snow, grins down into the pit and starts speaking fast.
@Leo keeps talking with a broad grin, sweeping one hand around the pit like a hotel host showing off a room.
@Leo cups a hand beside his mouth in mock secrecy as he goes on, his eyebrows dancing.
@Leo points straight down at @Roar and says the last words, his grin turning determined.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, still grinning, and leans further out over the crumbling rim.
Down in the pit @Roar glares up with his mouth closed and drags his fur-wrapped foot a little closer, wincing.
@Roar looks away at the broken spear beside him, lips pressed tight, his breath clouding in the cold air.
@Leo stays kneeling at the rim above @Roar, both silent, as clumps of snow trickle down the earth wall into the pit.

scenes.title: The Sinkhole (Hố sụt)
scenes.location: Một hố sụt sâu chừng ba mét giữa rừng thông phủ tuyết thời băng hà: miệng hố lởm chởm đất đá và rễ cây, đáy hố đầy tuyết và đất lở, một cây thông to mọc sát miệng hố, ánh nắng xiên qua tán thông.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng trên miệng hố cạnh cây thông to: miệng hố ở giữa khung, gốc thông bên trái, rừng thông phủ tuyết phía sau; ở 14.2 máy quay xuống đáy hố, Roar ngồi tựa vách đất bên phải, Leo quỳ bên trái, miệng hố sáng ở phía trên; ở 14.4 Roar ngồi trên tuyết sát miệng hố, Mia bên phải anh.
scenes.props: Áo choàng da của Mia bị cắt mép, ba dải da tết thành dây, dụng cụ đa năng nhỏ (multitool), hai que gỗ thẳng làm nẹp, chiếc khăn bandana đỏ của Leo, nút ghế (bowline) ở đầu dây, thân cây thông làm điểm tựa, ngọn giáo gãy đôi, gậy gỗ của Roar.
scenes.setting: A sinkhole in a snowy pine forest in the Ice Age at midday: a pit about three meters deep with steep walls of earth, rock and tangled roots, snow and collapsed earth at the bottom, a big pine tree right at the edge of the rim, slanting sunlight through the pines.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Three strips of hide, braided tight. One strip alone snaps. Three together can hold a grown man.
turns.tone: practical and brisk, teaching

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Like us. Two alone, pretty useless. Together, apparently, we can hold one very grumpy caveman down there.
turns.tone: slow and wry, a fond grin

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: the squeak of hide strips pulled tight, the small click of a folding multitool, wind in the pine branches, earth crumbling at the rim, soft breathing

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo kneeling at the rim of the sinkhole beside the big pine, @Mia cutting strips of hide from the hem of her cape with a small multitool, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia braiding three strips of hide with quick tight pulls, her face bent over the braid, locked off
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Mia onto @Leo holding the end of the braid with a lopsided smile, locked off
50mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo at the rim with the finished braided rope stretched between them, handheld

steps: @Mia kneels at the sinkhole rim, slices a long strip from the hem of her hide cape with a small multitool and is already speaking.
@Mia keeps talking evenly, laying three long strips of hide side by side on the snow in front of her.
@Mia holds up one single strip and gives it a sharp tug as she goes on, showing how thin it is.
@Mia hands the three knotted ends to @Leo to hold and keeps talking, her fingers already crossing the strips.
@Mia braids the three strips over and under with quick tight pulls as she keeps speaking, her eyes on her work.
@Mia pulls the braid tight and says the last words, glancing up at @Leo with a raised eyebrow.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, braiding on with quick fingers, while @Leo holds the knotted end steady.
@Leo looks from the braid to @Mia's face and starts speaking slowly, a lopsided smile spreading.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, pointing one finger at himself and then at @Mia, his eyebrows raised.
@Leo lets a loose strip of hide flop limply over his fingers as he goes on, pulling a comic face.
@Leo gives the finished braid a firm tug between his hands as he keeps talking, nodding at how strong it is.
@Leo jerks his thumb toward the dark pit beside them as he goes on, his grin widening.
@Leo leans over the crumbling rim to peer down into the sinkhole as he keeps talking with a smirk.
@Leo says the last words and closes his mouth, his eyes twinkling as he looks back at @Mia.
@Mia shakes her head with a dry half-smile, mouth closed, and pulls the braided rope tight between her fists.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Straight sticks, both sides. My lucky bandana holds it. Don't move.
turns.tone: calm and practical, steadying

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Why do you help me? I wanted the white to take you.
turns.tone: rough and puzzled, almost a mutter

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Because nobody gets left in a hole. Not even you.
turns.tone: slow and honest, quietly firm

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, a red bandana tied on the left wrist, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: cloth rustling as a bandana is untied, sticks scraping on frozen earth, a sharp hiss of breath through gritted teeth, loose soil trickling down the pit walls, wind high in the pines

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Leo kneeling beside @Roar at the bottom of the pit, laying two straight sticks along @Roar's swollen left ankle, handheld
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo onto @Roar gritting his teeth as @Leo unties the red bandana from his own wrist, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo looking up from the splint into @Roar's eyes, slow push-in
100mm extreme close-up of the red bandana knotted tight around the two straight sticks on @Roar's ankle, locked off

steps: @Leo kneels in the snow at the bottom of the pit beside @Roar, lays a straight stick along his swollen left ankle and is already speaking evenly.
@Leo keeps talking, setting a second straight stick along the inside of the ankle and holding both in place with one hand.
@Leo taps the red bandana on his own left wrist with a little grin as he goes on talking.
@Leo holds up a flat palm toward @Roar's face as he says the last words, his eyebrows raised firmly.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and @Roar, gritting his teeth, starts speaking low and rough, staring at him.
@Roar keeps talking in a gruff rumble as @Leo pulls at the knot of the red bandana on his own left wrist.
@Roar narrows his eyes under his heavy brows as he goes on, watching @Leo slide the red bandana off his wrist.
@Roar glances at the snow piled around them in the pit as he keeps talking, his jaw tight.
@Roar says the last words more quietly, his gaze dropping to the red cloth in @Leo's hands.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, breathing hard, as @Leo wraps the red bandana around both sticks and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, pulling the bandana snug around the splint and looking up into @Roar's eyes.
@Leo ties a firm double knot as he goes on, his voice low and steady, his face serious for once.
@Leo holds @Roar's gaze and says the next words with a small, crooked smile.
@Leo says the last words quietly and closes his mouth, his hands giving the red bandana a final tug.
In extreme close-up the red bandana sits knotted tight around the two straight sticks on @Roar's ankle, both men silent.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: A bowline. The rabbit comes out of the hole, goes round the tree, and back down the hole. It won't tighten on him.
turns.tone: patient teacher, clear and even

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Rabbit, tree, hole. Got it. Throw it down to him. Now pull, together!
turns.tone: fast and eager, rising to a shout

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: a braided hide rope creaking taut against pine bark, boots digging into snow, two people grunting as they pull, loose earth falling into the pit, wind in the pines

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo kneeling at the rim beside the big pine, @Mia twisting a small loop into the end of the braided hide rope, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia holding the half-tied knot up beside her face, locked off
35mm medium shot of @Mia passing the long rope around the rough trunk of the big pine at the rim, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo repeating the steps, then tossing the open loop down into the pit, handheld
24mm wide shot of @Mia and @Leo leaning back together on the braided rope, which runs around the pine trunk and pulls taut down into the hole, locked off

steps: @Mia kneels at the rim beside the big pine, twists a small loop into the braided hide rope and is already speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking, holding the little loop up for @Leo to see, the long rope trailing across the snow.
@Mia pokes the rope end up through the small loop like a rabbit popping out of its hole as she goes on.
@Mia keeps talking as she leads the end around behind the standing rope, her eyes flicking up to @Leo.
@Mia tucks the rope end back down through the loop and keeps explaining, lifting the knot up beside her face.
@Mia pulls the bowline snug with both hands and tugs the open loop to show it does not slide, still talking.
@Mia passes the long rope around the rough trunk of the big pine at the rim as she keeps talking evenly.
@Mia pulls the turn around the trunk tight and says the last words, glancing down into the pit.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, handing @Leo the end of the rope with the bowline loop.
@Leo takes the loop, nods quickly and starts speaking fast, tracing the steps in the air with one finger.
@Leo keeps talking fast, his finger drawing the path of the rope: up, around and back down.
@Leo leans over the crumbling rim and tosses the open loop down into the pit as he goes on talking.
@Leo wraps both hands around the braided rope behind @Mia and shouts the last words, bracing his boots in the snow.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as he and @Mia lean back together on the rope, which pulls taut down into the hole.
@Mia and @Leo haul hand over hand, mouths closed and breath clouding, as the rope creaks taut around the pine and down into the hole.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: You pulled me out of the earth. From today, he is my brother. And you are my sister.
turns.tone: slow and solemn, a sworn promise

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then, big brother, lean on us. It's a long walk home, and you're heavy.
turns.tone: warm and teasing, a little breathless

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt
wardrobe.@Roar: a long-sleeved tunic of dark reindeer hide that fully covers his chest, fur-lined hide trousers, a necklace of animal teeth, a wooden spear-thrower at his belt, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: heavy breathing after a climb, snow crunching under a wooden staff, the creak of a hide tunic, wind in the pine branches, a crow calling far away

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Roar sitting in the snow at the rim of the sinkhole with his splinted left ankle stretched out, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Roar laying his palm on his chest, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Roar onto @Mia crouching beside him in the snow, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Mia helping @Roar up onto his feet and his wooden staff at the rim of the sinkhole among the pines, locked off

steps: @Roar sits in the snow at the rim of the sinkhole, his splinted left ankle stretched out in front of him, and is already speaking slowly.
@Roar keeps talking slowly in his deep voice, brushing loose earth from his hide sleeves, his chest still heaving from the climb.
@Roar looks down at the red bandana knotted around the two sticks on his ankle as he goes on, his jaw working.
@Roar turns his head toward someone just out of frame to his left and keeps speaking, each word heavy and slow.
@Roar gives a slow deep nod toward the edge of the frame as he goes on speaking, his heavy brows lifting.
@Roar turns his dark eyes to @Mia crouching beside him and keeps talking, his gruff voice dropping lower.
@Roar lays his broad palm flat on his chest over the necklace of animal teeth as he goes on.
@Roar says the last words with his palm still on his chest, then closes his mouth, gazing steadily at @Mia.
@Mia blinks quickly with a small smile and starts speaking at an even pace, shifting closer to his side in the snow.
@Mia keeps talking as she ducks her shoulder under his big arm, a teasing glint in her green eyes.
@Mia picks up a long wooden staff from the snow and puts it in his hand as she goes on talking.
@Mia braces her boots and pushes upward under his arm as she keeps talking, her cheeks reddening with the effort.
@Mia says the last words with a breathless laugh as @Roar rises onto his good foot, leaning on the staff.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, steadying @Roar on his feet with his weight across her shoulders.
@Roar and @Mia stand together at the rim, his arm over her shoulders and the staff in his hand, both silent, breath clouding.

scenes.title: Muddy Water (Nước đục)
scenes.location: Bờ con sông băng thời băng hà buổi chiều nắng ấm, trời xanh không một gợn mây: nước sông đục ngầu màu bùn, chảy xiết, cuốn theo những tảng băng vỡ và cành cây; xa phía thượng nguồn là lưỡi sông băng dưới chân núi.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng trên bãi sỏi ven sông nhìn ngược lên thượng nguồn: dòng sông đục ngầu chảy từ phải sang trái, lưỡi sông băng ở xa nhất dưới trời xanh không mây; ở 15.3–15.4 tảng đá xám nơi Roar ngồi nằm bên trái khung, hang của bộ lạc ở phía hạ nguồn bên trái ngoài khung.
scenes.props: Dòng nước đục màu bùn cuốn băng vỡ và cành cây, bãi sỏi rung lạo xạo, lưỡi sông băng ở xa, tảng đá xám ven sông, gậy gỗ và cổ chân nẹp que buộc khăn đỏ của Roar, áo choàng da của Leo và Mia, camera đeo ngực của Leo.
scenes.setting: The bank of the icy river in the Ice Age valley on a warm sunny afternoon under a clear blue sky: the water suddenly brown and muddy, racing fast, carrying broken chunks of ice and branches, gravel bars along the bank, the distant glacier tongue at the head of the valley.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Leo, look at the river. This morning it was clear. Now it's brown, fast, and full of broken ice.
turns.tone: fast and worried, eyes on the river

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Maybe snow melting in the sun? It's warm today, finally.
turns.tone: easy and relaxed, enjoying the sun

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: No. Too fast.
turns.tone: flat and certain, low

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: the brown river roaring fast over gravel, chunks of ice knocking and grinding together, branches scraping past, birds calling in the warm sun, boots on wet gravel

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot of @Mia stopping short on the gravel bank of the racing brown river under a clear blue sky with @Leo a step behind her, handheld
85mm close-up of @Mia frowning down at the muddy water, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Leo tipping his face up to the warm sun and squinting at the clear blue sky, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia shaking her head, her eyes on the river, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo standing side by side on the gravel bank with the brown river racing behind them, locked off

steps: @Mia stops short on the gravel bank under the clear blue sky, points down at the river and is already speaking fast.
@Mia keeps talking quickly, her pointing finger following a chunk of broken ice tumbling past in the brown water.
@Mia glances back upstream toward the head of the valley as she goes on, her brows drawn tight.
@Mia crouches and scoops a handful of the muddy water, letting it run brown through her fingers as she keeps talking.
@Mia keeps talking fast, staring at the racing current, her jaw tight between the words.
@Mia flicks the brown water off her fingers and says the last words, her eyes fixed on the river.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, and beside her @Leo tilts his face up to the warm sun and starts speaking easily.
@Leo keeps talking at an even pace, squinting up at the cloudless blue sky with his eyes half shut.
@Leo spreads his arms to soak up the warmth as he goes on, a lazy smile on his face.
@Leo pushes back the fur collar of his hide cape and says the last words with a contented sigh.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, still smiling at the sun, as @Mia shakes her head and starts speaking slowly.
@Mia says the last words flatly and closes her mouth, her eyes never leaving the brown racing water.
@Leo's smile fades and he lowers his arms, mouth closed, following her gaze down to the river.
A big chunk of broken ice and a torn branch race past the gravel bar in the brown water, @Mia and @Leo silent on the bank.
@Mia and @Leo stand side by side on the gravel bank under the clear blue sky, mouths closed, watching the muddy river race past.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: That rumble isn't thunder. There's a lake behind the glacier. When the ice dam breaks, the whole lake comes down this valley at once.
turns.tone: low and tense, looking up at the glacier

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: How long do we have? Hours?
turns.tone: fast and alarmed, all jokes gone

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Maybe by tonight.
