turns.tone: slow and quiet, grim

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: a deep distant rumble rolling down the valley from the glacier, pebbles rattling and clicking on the trembling bank, the muddy river roaring past, chunks of ice grinding together

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo on the gravel bank as the pebbles at their feet begin to rattle, locked off
24mm wide shot past @Mia's profile toward the distant glacier tongue at the head of the valley under the clear blue sky, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia, her freckled face turning pale as she stares upstream, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Leo turning sharply toward her, handheld
85mm close-up of @Mia staring upstream with her jaw tight, slow push-in

steps: @Mia stands beside @Leo on the gravel bank and is already speaking at an even pace as the pebbles at their feet begin to rattle.
@Mia keeps talking, looking down as small stones tremble and click together on the shaking bank under her boots.
@Mia slowly turns her head upstream toward the head of the valley as she goes on, her voice low and tight.
@Mia raises one hand and points far away at the white glacier tongue under the blue sky as she keeps talking.
@Mia keeps speaking slowly, tracing a line in the air from the glacier down the valley with her pointing finger.
@Mia spreads both hands wide apart as she goes on, showing the size of the hidden lake behind the ice.
@Mia sweeps both hands down toward the river at her feet as she keeps talking, her freckled face turning pale.
@Mia keeps talking, her green eyes fixed on the distant glacier, her breath coming short and quick.
@Mia says the last words almost in a whisper, her hand still raised toward the head of the valley.
@Mia closes her mouth, and @Leo turns sharply from the glacier to her face and starts speaking fast.
@Leo keeps asking quickly, his grin gone, his grey-blue eyes searching her face.
@Leo finishes the question and closes his mouth, and @Mia swallows and starts answering slowly.
@Mia says the words quietly, still staring upstream, her raised hand slowly lowering to her side.
@Mia stands with her mouth closed and her jaw tight as another low rumble rolls down from the far glacier.
@Mia stays frozen, lips pressed tight, staring upstream while the pebbles on the bank go on trembling, silent.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Brother, big water is coming tonight. Your cave sits right on the river. Everyone must go up.
turns.tone: fast and urgent, pleading

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: The river runs the color of mud. My father told of this. The lake of the ice river breaks.
turns.tone: grave and slow, recalling old words

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Roar: a long-sleeved tunic of dark reindeer hide that fully covers his chest, fur-lined hide trousers, a necklace of animal teeth, a wooden spear-thrower at his belt, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: the muddy river roaring and rushing over the gravel bars, ice chunks knocking together, a wooden staff creaking under a hand, a warm breeze, a faint far-off rumble

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Leo crouching in front of @Roar, who sits on a grey boulder by the river with his splinted ankle stretched out and his staff in hand, handheld
85mm close-up of @Roar staring past @Leo at the brown racing water, slow push-in
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo onto @Roar on the boulder, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Roar and @Leo beside the flooding brown river with the glacier tongue far upstream, locked off

steps: @Leo crouches in front of @Roar, who sits on a grey boulder at the riverbank with his splinted leg stretched out, and is already talking fast.
@Leo keeps talking quickly, pointing back over his shoulder at the brown racing river full of broken ice.
@Leo points downstream toward the distant cave as he goes on, his words tumbling out.
@Leo raises his open palm higher and higher as he keeps talking, showing the water climbing.
@Leo points straight up at the limestone cliffs above the valley as he says the last words, his eyes urgent.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, breathing hard, while @Roar stares past him at the muddy water without blinking.
@Roar keeps staring at the river for a long moment, then starts speaking slowly in his deep rough voice.
@Roar keeps talking low, watching a big chunk of ice roll over in the brown current, his heavy brows drawn down.
@Roar's hand tightens on the wooden staff as he goes on, his voice gruff and grave.
@Roar lifts his eyes upstream toward the glacier tongue at the head of the valley as he keeps speaking.
@Roar touches the necklace of animal teeth at his chest as he goes on, his eyes far away.
@Roar turns his dark eyes to @Leo and keeps talking slowly, every word heavy.
@Roar says the last words and gives one slow, grave nod, his face hard.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, his face set, as @Leo slowly straightens up in front of him.
@Roar and @Leo stay by the roaring brown river, mouths closed, both looking upstream at the distant glacier tongue.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Grandmother will not believe two strangers. The sky is too blue. But she will hear me. I will speak for you.
turns.tone: slow and resolute, giving his word

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then we walk fast. Lean on me, brother. All your weight.
turns.tone: firm and warm, already moving

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt
wardrobe.@Roar: a long-sleeved tunic of dark reindeer hide that fully covers his chest, fur-lined hide trousers, a necklace of animal teeth, a wooden spear-thrower at his belt, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: a wooden staff thudding on wet gravel, uneven limping footsteps, heavy breathing, the brown river roaring alongside, ice chunks grinding in the current

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Roar pushing himself up off the grey boulder on his wooden staff, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Roar squinting up at the clear blue sky, locked off
50mm medium two-shot of @Mia slipping her shoulder under @Roar's arm on the gravel bank, handheld
24mm wide shot of @Mia and @Roar hurrying along the riverbank beside the racing brown river, handheld follow

steps: @Roar plants his wooden staff in the gravel, heaves himself up off the boulder onto his good foot and is already speaking slowly.
@Roar keeps talking in a deep slow voice, steadying himself on the staff, his splinted ankle lifted off the ground.
@Roar tilts his head back and squints up at the clear cloudless blue sky as he goes on.
@Roar lets out a short snort through his nose at the bright blue sky as he keeps talking, his heavy brows raised.
@Roar looks down at @Mia beside him and keeps speaking, his deep voice firm and slow.
@Roar thumps his broad palm against his own chest as he goes on, his jaw set hard.
@Roar points his chin downstream toward the clan's cave as he keeps talking, the staff steady in his fist.
@Roar keeps talking with weight in every word, his dark eyes fixed on @Mia's face.
@Roar says the last words slowly and lays one big hand on her shoulder, the staff steady in the other.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth with a firm nod, as @Mia ducks under his arm and starts speaking.
@Mia keeps talking at an even pace, hooking his heavy arm across her shoulders and holding his wrist.
@Mia sets off along the gravel bank with him as she goes on, her boots crunching, her face set.
@Mia glances up at him with a quick smile as she keeps talking, taking more of his weight.
@Mia says the last words and closes her mouth, bracing as @Roar leans his full weight on her shoulders.
@Mia and @Roar limp quickly along the bank beside the racing brown river, both silent, breathing hard.

scenes.title: Nobody Believes (Không ai tin)
scenes.location: Trong hang của bộ lạc chiều muộn: nắng vàng xiên qua cửa hang vòm, măng đá hình voi ma mút, vách đá trơn, bếp lửa cháy đỏ, cả bộ lạc tụ quanh bếp; dưới cửa hang, con sông đục ngầu đã dâng sát chân thềm.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng trong hang nhìn ra cửa hang vòm: bếp lửa ở giữa, cả hang ngồi vòng quanh bếp, Grandma Moon ngồi bên trái bếp, cửa hang với trời xanh và con sông đục ở xa phía sau; người đứng nói ở bên phải bếp (Leo ở 16.1, Roar ở 16.2–16.3); ở 16.4 máy quay sát bếp lửa, Grandma Moon bên trái, Pebble bên phải.
scenes.props: Bếp lửa đỏ, sừng lửa bằng sừng bò rừng nút rêu còn than hồng, áo choàng da tuần lộc viền lông xám của Grandma Moon, gậy gỗ và nẹp chân buộc khăn đỏ của Roar, măng đá hình voi ma mút, ổ lông thú quanh bếp.
scenes.setting: Late afternoon inside the large Ice Age clan cave: golden light through the wide arched mouth, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, bare rock walls, the whole clan gathered around the hearth, and below the entrance the muddy river now loud, brown and high.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Grandmother, the lake behind the ice river is breaking. Tonight the big water comes. This cave will flood. Please, everyone must go up!
turns.tone: fast and urgent, close to begging

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The sun is still high. The sky is blue.
turns.tone: slow and calm, unmoved

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.extras: the clan, men, women and children in sewn hide tunics and fur cloaks covered from shoulders to knees, sits around the hearth in soft focus
clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling, the muddy river roaring loud below the cave mouth, the clan murmuring, footsteps on packed earth, an ember popping

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Leo standing in the middle of the cave pointing back at the wide arched mouth and the muddy river below, the clan around the hearth in soft focus, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo with sweat shining on his brow, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo onto @Moon seated calmly by the hearth, slow push-in
24mm wide shot of the golden cave with the clan around the hearth, @Moon seated and @Leo standing alone in the middle, locked off

steps: @Leo stands in the middle of the cave in front of the hearth, points back at the wide arched mouth and is already speaking fast.
@Leo keeps talking quickly, sweeping his arm toward the loud brown river below the entrance, his eyes urgent.
Around the hearth clan members in hide tunics turn their heads toward @Leo as he goes on talking fast.
@Leo raises one flat hand slowly from knee height to above his head as he keeps talking, showing the water rising.
@Leo presses both palms together toward @Moon in a pleading gesture as he goes on, sweat shining on his brow.
@Leo points up at the rock ceiling, then toward the cliffs outside, still talking fast and breathless.
@Leo spreads his arms wide to take in the whole clan as he says the last words, his voice cracking.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, chest heaving, as @Moon, seated calmly by the hearth, starts speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, her pale eyes turned past @Leo toward the bright blue sky beyond the cave mouth.
@Moon lifts one weathered hand toward the golden light pouring through the entrance as she goes on.
@Moon rests her hand back on the fire horn in her lap and keeps speaking, unhurried, her face calm.
@Moon finishes the words and closes her mouth, gazing out at the cloudless sky.
@Leo's shoulders sag and his mouth stays closed as he looks from @Moon to the silent clan around the hearth.
@Leo turns toward the cave mouth, lips pressed together, listening to the loud brown water rushing below.
Golden light falls across the silent clan around the hearth while @Moon sits calm and @Leo stands alone in the middle of the cave.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Strangers speak of water when the sky is blue. Why should the clan climb in the dark for them?
turns.tone: slow and cool, weighing every word

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Because they are no strangers. They pulled me from the earth. I trust them.
turns.tone: firm and upright, deep conviction

wardrobe.@Roar: a long-sleeved tunic of dark reindeer hide that fully covers his chest, fur-lined hide trousers, a necklace of animal teeth, a wooden spear-thrower at his belt, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, fur-wrapped feet

clips.extras: the clan, men, women and children in sewn hide tunics and fur cloaks covered from shoulders to knees, sits around the hearth murmuring in soft focus
clips.sfx: low doubtful murmurs of the clan, the hearth fire popping, the loud brown river rushing below the entrance, a wooden staff tapping on stone, limping steps

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of @Moon seated by the hearth looking just past the lens, the murmuring clan behind her in soft focus, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Moon's lined face in the firelight, locked off
35mm medium shot of @Roar limping into the middle of the cave on his wooden staff and planting himself in front of @Moon, handheld
85mm close-up of @Roar with his jaw set, locked off

steps: @Moon sits by the hearth with the fire horn in her lap, looks just past the lens toward the strangers and is already speaking slowly.
Behind @Moon clan members in hide tunics and fur cloaks lean their heads together and murmur as she keeps talking.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly, one weathered finger lifted toward the bright blue sky beyond the cave mouth.
@Moon narrows her calm pale eyes as she goes on, her voice low and husky, every word heavy.
@Moon turns her gaze across the frowning faces of the clan around the hearth as she keeps talking.
@Moon points up toward the dark cliffs above the cave mouth as she goes on, her eyebrows lifting.
@Moon raises her eyebrows in a slow question as she keeps speaking, her shell necklace clicking.
@Moon says the last words slowly, her pale eyes hard, and folds her hands over the fire horn.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth as @Roar limps into the middle of the cave on his wooden staff and starts speaking.
@Roar plants himself squarely in front of @Moon, leaning on the staff, and keeps talking in a deep firm voice.
@Roar straightens his broad back despite his splinted ankle as he goes on, his chin raised.
@Roar sweeps one big arm back toward the side of the cave where the strangers stand out of frame as he keeps speaking.
@Roar lays his palm on his chest over the necklace of animal teeth as he goes on, his jaw set.
@Roar says the last words and closes his mouth, his dark eyes locked on @Moon's.
@Roar stands firm before the hearth, mouth closed, as the murmuring clan behind him falls silent.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: I hated them most of all. And I say it: climb tonight. If no water comes, the shame is mine.
turns.tone: loud and steady, owning his old hatred

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Then we climb. But if the river sleeps, the strangers leave at dawn.
turns.tone: slow and final, rising to her feet

wardrobe.@Roar: a long-sleeved tunic of dark reindeer hide that fully covers his chest, fur-lined hide trousers, a necklace of animal teeth, a wooden spear-thrower at his belt, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, fur-wrapped feet

clips.extras: the whole clan, men, women and children in sewn hide tunics and fur cloaks covered from shoulders to knees, sits silently around the hearth in soft focus
clips.sfx: a hush falling over the cave, the hearth fire crackling, the river roaring below the entrance, the rustle of a hide cloak, shells clicking on a necklace

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Roar turning on his staff to face the whole clan seated around the hearth, his palm on his chest, slow pan
24mm wide shot from behind the seated clan toward @Roar standing tall by the hearth, locked off
85mm close-up of @Moon looking up at @Roar for a long moment, slow push-in
50mm medium shot of @Moon rising to her feet and drawing her cloak around her, locked off

steps: @Roar turns on his staff to face the whole clan around the hearth, his palm on his chest, and is already speaking firmly.
@Roar keeps talking in his deep rough voice, his dark eyes moving from face to face around the fire.
@Roar points back toward the side of the cave where the strangers stand out of frame, still speaking, his brows heavy.
@Roar thumps his palm twice on his chest over the animal teeth as he goes on, his voice rising.
@Roar lifts his arm and points up toward the cliffs beyond the cave mouth as he keeps speaking.
The clan sits utterly still around the hearth, faces turned up to @Roar as he keeps talking.
@Roar lowers his arm and taps his own chest once more as he says the last words, his jaw set.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, standing tall on his staff, and the whole cave falls silent.
@Moon looks up at @Roar for a long moment, then starts speaking slowly, her pale eyes steady.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, setting one hand on the rock beside her and pushing herself up.
@Moon rises to her feet as she goes on, straight-backed, the fire horn hanging at her hip.
@Moon draws her long reindeer-hide cloak around her shoulders as she keeps speaking, her voice level.
@Moon turns her face toward the strangers out of frame as she says the last words, unsmiling.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, fastening the grey fur collar of her cloak at her neck.
@Moon stands straight-backed by the hearth with her cloak drawn close, mouth closed, as the clan begins to rise around her.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Little one. You let the fire die once. Tonight you carry it up the cliff to the high cave.
turns.tone: slow and solemn, entrusting a duty

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: This time I won't let the fire die, Grandmother. Not even for one breath!
turns.tone: fast and fierce, a child's solemn vow

clips.sfx: embers hissing softly inside a hollow horn, the hearth fire crackling, the river roaring below the cave mouth, furs rustling, a child's quick breath

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Moon bending toward @Pebble by the hearth, holding out the hollow fire horn, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Moon's lined face in the firelight, locked off
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Moon onto @Pebble hugging the fire horn to his chest, locked off
100mm extreme close-up of @Pebble's shining eyes and cold-pink cheeks above the glowing fire horn, locked off

steps: @Moon bends toward @Pebble beside the hearth, holding out the hollow aurochs fire horn in both hands, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, a thin curl of smoke rising from the moss plug of the horn between them.
@Moon touches one finger gently to @Pebble's forehead as she goes on, her pale eyes stern but kind.
@Pebble tucks in his lower lip and drops his eyes to his fur-wrapped feet as @Moon keeps speaking.
@Moon lifts his chin with one weathered finger and keeps talking, her low husky voice gentle.
@Moon places the warm fire horn into @Pebble's two small hands as she goes on, her hands over his.
@Moon points up toward the cliff above the cave mouth as she keeps speaking, slow and clear.
@Moon says the last words and lets go of the horn, her eyes resting on the boy.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth as @Pebble hugs the fire horn to his chest and starts speaking fast.
@Pebble keeps talking quickly, pulling himself up straight with his chin high, the horn clutched tight against his tunic.
@Pebble shakes his mop of brown hair hard as he goes on, his big dark eyes shining in the firelight.
@Pebble puffs out his cold-pink cheeks for an instant, then says the next words in a rush.
@Pebble says the last words, hugging the horn tighter, his eyes shining bright with pride.
@Pebble stands as straight as he can, mouth closed, the faint red glow of the embers lighting his chin.
In extreme close-up @Pebble's big dark eyes shine above the moss-plugged horn, lips pressed tight, the embers glowing red.

scenes.title: Flood Night (Đêm lũ)
scenes.location: Đêm trăng trên mỏm đá trước hang cao trên vách núi thời băng hà: cả bộ lạc chen chúc trên mỏm đá, quấn lông thú, đuốc lập loè; phía dưới, dòng lũ trắng xoá gầm lên, cuồn cuộn băng vỡ và cây gãy, tràn qua thung lũng dưới ánh trăng.
scenes.axis: Ở 17.1 và 17.3 máy quay đứng trên mỏm đá trước hang cao: vách đá bên trái, mép vách và dòng lũ phía dưới bên phải; 17.2 cắt xen giữa hang dưới ngập nước (gờ đá khô ở vách sau, cửa hang ở xa) và mỏm đá trên vách (Leo cúi qua mép vách nhìn xuống); ở 17.4 máy quay đứng trong hang dưới ngập nước, gờ đá khô ở vách sau bên phải, cửa hang ngập nước bên trái.
scenes.props: Đuốc lập loè, lông thú của bộ lạc, sợi dây da tết ba sợi vòng qua một mỏm đá làm điểm tựa, đèn pin đội đầu của Leo, sừng lửa trong tay Pebble với đốm than đỏ, gờ đá khô cao ngang ngực, nước lũ đục ngầu, băng vỡ và cành gãy trôi, gậy và nẹp chân buộc khăn đỏ của Roar.
scenes.setting: Moonlit night during a great flood in the Ice Age: a rock ledge in front of a small high cave on a limestone cliff, the clan huddled in furs with flickering torches, and far below a roaring brown flood full of ice chunks and broken trees surging through the valley toward the mouth of the lower cave.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: I counted twice. Seventeen. We should be eighteen. Where is Pebble? And where's the fire horn?
turns.tone: fast and frantic, breath short

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The fire horn... he left it by the hearth below. He went back down for it.
turns.tone: slow and shaking, a trembling voice

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt
wardrobe.@Moon: a long reindeer-hide cloak with a grey fur collar over a knee-length sewn hide tunic, a necklace of pierced sea shells, empty-handed with no horn, fur-wrapped feet

clips.extras: the clan, men, women and children wrapped in furs over hide tunics covered from shoulders to knees, huddles along the torchlit cliff ledge in soft focus
clips.sfx: the roaring flood far below, wind whipping across the cliff ledge, torches sputtering and crackling, children whimpering in the furs, ice chunks grinding together in the dark

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Mia moving along the crowded torchlit ledge, pointing at each huddled clan member as she counts, handheld follow
85mm close-up of @Mia freezing with her pointing hand still raised, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Moon, empty-handed, turning from the huddled clan toward the edge of the ledge, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Moon looking down over the rim, torchlight shaking on her lined face, locked off
24mm wide shot from the moonlit ledge down to the roaring brown flood surging through the valley into the mouth of the lower cave, locked off

steps: @Mia moves along the crowded torchlit ledge, pointing at each huddled clan member in turn, and is already speaking fast.
@Mia keeps talking quickly, her finger jumping from one fur-wrapped figure to the next in the flickering torchlight.
@Mia reaches the end of the ledge, spins round and counts back along the row, still talking fast, breath clouding.
@Mia freezes with her pointing hand in the air as she goes on, her green eyes darting over the faces.
@Mia's hand drops and she says the last words in a rush, scanning the ledge, her chest rising fast.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, breathing hard, as @Moon, empty-handed, lifts her head and starts speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, opening her two empty hands in front of her and looking down at them.
@Moon turns her head toward the dark edge of the ledge as she goes on, her husky voice trembling.
@Moon steps slowly to the rim and looks far down at the old cave below as she keeps speaking.
@Moon's lined face catches the torchlight as she goes on in a low shaking voice, her eyes on the flood.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly, her fingers clutching the grey fur collar of her cloak at her neck.
@Moon says the last words almost in a whisper, staring down at the brown water swirling into the lower cave mouth.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, her lips trembling, her empty hands hanging at her sides.
@Moon stands at the rim with her mouth closed, the torchlight shaking on her face as the flood roars below.
Far below the moonlit ledge the roaring brown flood surges through the valley into the mouth of the lower cave, the ledge above silent.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Fire! Spark! I have the fire horn! But the water is coming in! I can't get back up!
turns.tone: a high frantic shout over rushing water

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Hold on! Don't move! Stay up on that high ledge, Pebble! I'm coming down to you!
turns.tone: a loud urgent shout down the cliff

clips.setting: Night inside the large lower Ice Age cave as it floods: muddy brown water pouring in through the wide mouth and spreading across the floor, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, a dry rock ledge at chest height along the back wall, a beam of headlamp light in the dark, a braided hide rope hanging down the cliff above the entrance.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: floodwater pouring and gurgling into a cave, echoing drips, ice chunks knocking on rock, wind howling across the cliff, a hide rope creaking

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Pebble in the dark flooded lower cave, standing on a dry rock ledge at chest height against the back wall and hugging the fire horn, handheld
85mm close-up of @Pebble in the lower cave shouting up toward the cave mouth, the horn pressed to his chest, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Leo on the moonlit cliff ledge above, leaning out over the rim with one hand on the braided hide rope, a headlamp on his brow, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo on the cliff ledge shouting down into the dark, torchlight and moonlight on his face, locked off
24mm wide shot of the flooding lower cave, brown water spreading across the floor around the mammoth-shaped stalagmite and @Pebble small and dry on the high ledge at the back wall, locked off

steps: In the dark flooded lower cave @Pebble stands on a dry rock ledge at chest height against the back wall, hugging the fire horn, already shouting fast.
@Pebble keeps shouting up toward the cave mouth, the horn clutched to his chest, his big dark eyes wide in a sweep of headlamp light.
Below @Pebble's fur-wrapped feet muddy brown water pours across the cave floor as he keeps shouting, pressing his back to the rock.
@Pebble lifts the moss-plugged horn a little to show it, still shouting, a faint red glow seeping from the plug.
@Pebble looks down at the brown water swirling around the base of the ledge and keeps shouting, his shoulders hunched.
@Pebble shouts the last words and closes his mouth, pressing himself and the horn flat against the dry back wall.
Up on the moonlit cliff ledge @Leo leans out over the rim, one hand on the braided hide rope, and starts shouting down fast.
@Leo keeps shouting into the dark below, his headlamp beam pointing down the wet cliff face, the wind tugging his hide cape.
@Leo holds up a flat palm toward the cave below as he goes on shouting, his face lit by torchlight and moonlight.
@Leo wraps the braided rope twice around his hand as he keeps shouting down, his jaw set.
@Leo shouts the last words, swinging one leg over the rim of the ledge, the rope held tight in both hands.
Back in the flooding lower cave @Pebble lifts his head toward the cave mouth, mouth closed, as @Leo's shout echoes down from the cliff above.
The muddy brown water spreads wider across the cave floor around the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, while @Pebble stays dry on the high ledge, silent.
A beam of headlamp light swings across the cave mouth from above, and @Pebble squints into it, lips pressed tight, the horn held to his chest.
@Pebble hugs the fire horn to his heart on the dry ledge, mouth closed, as broken ice chunks drift in through the flooded cave mouth.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: We've got you! Roar is holding the rope with me! Go slow on the wet rock!
turns.tone: a loud shout down into the dark

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Go, brother. My foot is weak, but my arms are not. I hold you.
turns.tone: slow and strained, gritted resolve

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Please, Leo. Be careful.
turns.tone: a soft trembling whisper

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt
wardrobe.@Roar: a long-sleeved tunic of dark reindeer hide that fully covers his chest, fur-lined hide trousers, a necklace of animal teeth, a wooden spear-thrower at his belt, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: a braided hide rope creaking taut over wet rock, wind gusting across the ledge, torches sputtering, the flood roaring far below, strained breathing

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Roar on the moonlit ledge holding the braided rope, which runs around a knob of rock and down over the wet rim, handheld
85mm close-up of @Mia shouting down over the rim, torchlight on her face, handheld
50mm medium shot of @Roar sitting braced on the rock with his splinted leg stretched out and both arms locked on the rope, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia leaning over the edge and whispering into the dark, slow push-in

steps: @Mia kneels at the wet rim of the moonlit ledge holding the taut braided rope, leans over the dark drop and is already shouting down fast.
@Mia keeps shouting into the darkness below, the rope creaking tight around a knob of rock behind her.
Behind @Mia, @Roar sits braced on the rock with his splinted leg stretched out and both arms locked on the rope as she keeps shouting.
@Mia cups one hand beside her mouth and shouts on, her braid swinging over the edge in the cold wind.
@Mia keeps shouting down the cliff, then puts both hands back on the rope, staring into the dark.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, gripping the rope again, as @Roar sets his jaw and starts speaking slowly.
@Roar keeps talking in a deep rough voice, leaning back against the rope with his arms rigid and his heavy brows down.
@Roar pushes his good foot hard against a ridge of rock as he goes on, the rope creaking in his fists.
@Roar glances at his splinted ankle with its red bandana as he keeps speaking, then back at the drop.
@Roar flexes his broad shoulders, taking more of the rope's weight, as he goes on in a low steady voice.
@Roar says the next words through his teeth, his knuckles pale on the rope, his staff lying beside him.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, holding the rope like stone, as @Mia leans out over the edge again.
@Mia looks down into the darkness and starts whispering slowly, her breath clouding in the moonlight.
@Mia whispers the last words to herself and closes her mouth, her eyes glistening in the torchlight.
@Mia keeps both hands tight on the trembling rope, lips pressed together, staring down at the roaring flood below.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I've got you, little one. Climb onto my shoulders. Hold the fire horn up high, above your head, okay?
turns.tone: calm and gentle over the roar of water

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: You came down for me! Into the big cold water, for me and for the fire!
turns.tone: fast and tearful, voice wobbling

clips.setting: Night inside the large lower Ice Age cave as it floods: muddy brown water pouring in through the wide mouth and spreading across the floor, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, a dry rock ledge at chest height along the back wall, a beam of headlamp light in the dark, a braided hide rope hanging down the cliff above the entrance.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: thigh-deep water sloshing around wading legs, echoing splashes in the cave, the flood pouring in through the mouth, a hide rope creaking, a boy sniffling

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Leo wading thigh-deep through the brown floodwater toward the dry ledge at the back wall, the braided rope tied around his waist, his headlamp beam cutting the dark, handheld follow
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Pebble on the dry ledge down onto @Leo reaching up with both arms, locked off
85mm close-up of @Pebble perched on @Leo's shoulders holding the fire horn high above his head, slow push-in
24mm wide shot of the dark flooded cave with @Leo wading thigh-deep toward the entrance and @Pebble on his shoulders holding the horn high, locked off

steps: @Leo wades thigh-deep through the muddy brown floodwater toward the dry ledge, the braided rope tied around his waist, already speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking, his headlamp beam sweeping up the back wall and landing on @Pebble crouched on the dry ledge with the fire horn.
@Leo reaches the foot of the ledge, the water swirling around his thighs, and keeps talking calmly as he lifts both arms.
@Leo turns his back to the ledge and pats his own shoulders with both hands as he goes on talking.
@Pebble steps off the dry ledge onto @Leo's shoulders, hugging the horn, as @Leo keeps talking and steadies the boy's legs.
@Leo holds @Pebble's fur-wrapped ankles firmly against his chest as he goes on talking, the water at his thighs.
@Leo tilts his head up toward the boy and says the last words, nodding at the horn.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as @Pebble lifts the fire horn high above his head and starts speaking fast, his voice wobbling.
@Pebble keeps talking quickly, his chin trembling, the moss-plugged horn raised high with a red ember glowing inside.
@Pebble looks down at the dark water swirling around @Leo's thighs as he goes on, his big eyes shining wet.
@Pebble keeps talking fast, hugging @Leo's head with one arm and holding the horn high with the other.
@Pebble sniffs hard as he goes on, his lower lip wobbling, the ember in the horn still glowing red above the water.
@Pebble says the last words, then closes his mouth and presses his cheek to the top of @Leo's head.
@Leo turns and wades back toward the flooded cave mouth, mouth closed, the headlamp beam leading through the dark, @Pebble dry on his shoulders.
The rope around @Leo's waist tightens toward the entrance as he wades on through thigh-deep water, @Pebble holding the glowing horn high, both silent.

scenes.title: Three Million and One Boy (Ba triệu người và một cậu bé)
scenes.location: Một tảng đá cao, khô, nhô lên giữa dòng lũ ngay dưới chân vách núi thời băng hà, đêm trăng: nước lũ đục ngầu cuộn xiết quanh chân đá, băng vỡ trôi qua; vách đá dựng đứng phía sau, mép vách cao chừng sáu mét, sợi dây da tết thả xuống từ trên ấy.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng dưới chân vách núi nhìn lên: tảng đá khô giữa dòng lũ ở tiền cảnh, vách đá ướt dựng đứng phía sau, mép vách có đuốc ở trên cao; các cảnh từ mép vách nhìn thẳng xuống tảng đá và dòng lũ; 18.4 trở lại mỏm đá trước hang cao, vách đá bên trái, mép vách bên phải.
scenes.props: Đỉnh tảng đá phẳng khô, sừng lửa với đốm than đỏ áp vào ngực Pebble, tấm lông thú quấn quanh Pebble, sợi dây da tết thả từ mép vách, nút ghế (bowline), đôi tay phồng rộp của Leo, đai đeo ngực tuột khoá và chiếc camera vuông rơi xuống dòng lũ, đuốc trên mép vách, đứa trẻ quấn lông thú ngủ ở hậu cảnh.
scenes.setting: Moonlit night at the foot of the limestone cliff during the flood: the dry flat top of a tall boulder standing above churning brown water and drifting ice, the sheer wet cliff rising about six meters behind it, torchlight at the rim above, a braided hide rope hanging down the rock face.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Made it. We're above the water now. Is the fire still alive in that horn?
turns.tone: fast and breathless, relieved

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Still red. Still warm. I kept it close to my heart, like Grandmother does.
turns.tone: proud and steady, a little solemn

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Good boy. Now we wait.
turns.tone: slow and tired, a warm smile

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera

clips.sfx: the brown flood churning and roaring around the boulder, ice chunks grinding past, heavy panting, the soft hiss of an ember, wind along the cliff

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Leo and @Pebble on the dry flat top of a tall boulder, @Pebble in @Leo's lap, the brown flood churning below in the moonlight, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo panting, water dripping from his beard, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Pebble opening the fold of fur wrapped around him to show the fire horn against his tunic, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Leo smiling tiredly down at the boy, locked off
100mm extreme close-up of a red ember glowing in the moss plug of the fire horn, locked off

steps: @Leo sits on the dry flat top of the tall boulder with @Pebble in his lap, chest heaving, and is already speaking fast between gasps.
@Leo keeps talking breathlessly, glancing down at the brown flood churning around the foot of the boulder in the moonlight.
@Leo wraps both arms tighter around @Pebble as he goes on, water dripping from his muddy sleeves.
@Leo looks down at the bulge under the boy's fur wrap and asks the last words, his eyebrows raised.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, catching his breath, as @Pebble looks up at him with wide eyes.
@Pebble pulls open the fold of fur wrapped around him and starts speaking at an even pace, chin lifted proudly.
@Pebble keeps talking, showing the fire horn pressed tight against the front of his hide tunic, a red glow at the moss plug.
@Pebble cups both small hands around the warm horn as he goes on, his cold-pink cheeks lit faintly red.
@Pebble pats the left side of his chest over his heart as he keeps talking, his big dark eyes solemn.
@Pebble lifts his chin and straightens his back like a little clan elder as he says the last words.
@Pebble finishes and closes his mouth, wrapping the fur back over the horn, as @Leo smiles down tiredly and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly and softly, ruffling the boy's messy brown hair with one muddy hand.
@Leo says the last words, closes his mouth and rests his chin on top of @Pebble's head, both breathing hard.
@Leo and @Pebble sit huddled together on the dry boulder top, mouths closed, as the brown flood roars past below them.
In extreme close-up a red ember glows steadily in the moss plug of the fire horn, safe and dry, both of them silent.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Here's the rope! Tie a bowline around him, like at the hole this morning! Rabbit, tree, hole!
turns.tone: a loud urgent shout down the cliff

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Rabbit out, round the tree, back down the hole. It won't tighten. Pull him up, slowly!
turns.tone: focused and steady, then a loud call up

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: a rope end landing on wet rock with a soft thud, the flood roaring, the creak of a hide rope pulling taut, wind gusting down the cliff, torches crackling high above

shots.camera: 35mm high-angle medium shot of @Mia kneeling at the torchlit cliff rim, dropping the end of the braided rope down the wet rock face, handheld
85mm close-up of @Mia shouting down over the rim, torchlight on her face, locked off
50mm low-angle medium shot of @Leo alone on the dry boulder top below, framed tight on him with the rope end in his blistered hands, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo's face bent low over his blistered hands as they pull a bowline snug against a patch of grey fur, locked off
24mm wide shot looking up the sheer wet cliff as the braided rope rises taut toward the torchlight at the rim, locked off

steps: @Mia kneels at the torchlit rim of the cliff, drops the end of the braided rope down the wet rock face and is already shouting fast.
@Mia keeps shouting down, feeding the rope hand over hand over the edge, her braid swinging in the wind.
@Mia leans further out over the drop as she goes on shouting, her free hand braced on the wet rock.
@Mia draws the knot in the air with one finger, up, around and down, as she keeps shouting.
@Mia shouts the last words down the cliff, her face lit orange by torchlight, her eyes wide.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, holding the rope steady at the rim and staring down into the dark.
Below on the boulder top @Leo catches the swinging rope end in his blistered hands and starts speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking as he twists a small loop into the rope, his eyes on his fingers, water dripping from his hair.
@Leo passes the rope end up through the loop as he goes on talking, his blistered fingers shaking with cold.
@Leo wraps the end around the standing rope and tucks it back down through the loop as he keeps talking.
@Leo pulls the bowline snug against a patch of grey fur with both hands and tugs it hard to test it, still talking.
@Leo looks up the cliff toward the rim, says the last words loudly and closes his mouth.
The braided rope tightens with a creak and begins to rise slowly up the sheer wet cliff toward the torchlight, silent.
The taut rope climbs steadily up the rock face in the moonlight, swaying gently, silent above the roaring flood.
At the top of the cliff the rope slides over the torchlit rim, still taut and rising, while the flood churns far below, silent.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Leo, your camera! It's gone, in the water! Seven days of footage, all of it!
turns.tone: a loud stunned shout down the cliff

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Let it go. Three million viewers aren't worth one boy holding the fire. Pull me up, Mia. Please.
turns.tone: slow and calm, certain, a little breathless

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty mud-streaked red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, no bandana on his wrists, a black chest harness holding a small square chest camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: a buckle clicking open, a small hard object clattering down wet rock and plopping into the flood, the rope creaking under strain, boots scraping on wet stone, the roaring flood

shots.camera: 50mm high-angle medium two-shot from beside @Mia at the rim, her face in profile in the foreground, looking down the wet cliff at @Leo climbing the rope as the square camera slips from his chest harness, handheld
85mm close-up of @Mia shouting down, torchlight shaking on her face, locked off
35mm medium shot of @Leo hanging on the rope halfway up the wet cliff, looking down at the flood and then up, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo looking up toward the rim with the rope in both blistered hands, slow push-in
24mm wide shot of @Leo climbing toward the torchlit rim while @Mia leans out and hauls on the rope, the flood roaring below, locked off

steps: @Mia leans over the torchlit rim holding the rope and is already shouting fast as the buckle of @Leo's chest harness slips open below her.
The small square camera slides off @Leo's chest and tumbles down the wet cliff past his boots, while @Mia keeps shouting, reaching downward.
The camera bounces off the boulder below and vanishes into the churning brown flood, while @Mia keeps shouting down.
@Mia keeps shouting fast, her eyes wide, torchlight shaking on her face, the rope wrapped tight around her fists.
@Mia shouts the last words and closes her mouth, staring down at the spot where the camera vanished.
Halfway up the cliff @Leo hangs on the rope, looks down at the flood for one long second, then starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, his eyes on the brown water where a few ice chunks drift past the boulder.
@Leo turns his face away from the water and up toward the torchlit rim as he goes on, his voice low and steady.
@Leo shifts one blistered hand higher on the braided rope as he keeps talking, wet hair stuck to his forehead.
@Leo looks straight up toward @Mia far above and keeps speaking, his grey-blue eyes calm and certain.
@Leo pulls himself up another arm's length on the rope as he goes on, his jaw set, his breath clouding.
@Leo says the next words more softly, still looking up, his boots finding the wet rock.
@Leo says the last word, closes his mouth and climbs again, hand over hand on the braided rope.
@Leo climbs steadily toward the torchlit rim, mouth closed, while @Mia leans out and hauls on the rope above him.
@Mia and @Leo pull and climb together, both silent, the rope taut between them, the flood roaring far below the cliff.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Don't ever do that again! I wasn't quitting the job, Leo. I was quitting you. Because I thought you'd never be real.
turns.tone: fast and tearful, breaking into a sob

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I'm real now. And I'm not going anywhere without you.
turns.tone: slow and soft, completely honest

clips.setting: Moonlit night during a great flood in the Ice Age: a rock ledge in front of a small high cave on a limestone cliff, the clan huddled in furs with flickering torches, and far below a roaring brown flood full of ice chunks and broken trees surging through the valley toward the mouth of the lower cave.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.extras: a small clan child wrapped in furs, covered from shoulders to knees, asleep against the rock wall in soft focus in the background, face hidden
clips.sfx: wet boots scraping over the rim, ragged panting, a woman sobbing, torches crackling, the distant roar of the flood below, a sleeping child's slow breathing

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Leo rolling over the wet rim onto the moonlit ledge and @Mia dropping to her knees beside him, handheld
85mm close-up of @Mia with tears streaming, her fist pressed against @Leo's chest, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Mia onto @Leo propped on one elbow, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Mia and @Leo kneeling forehead to forehead on the torchlit ledge, a small child asleep in furs in soft focus behind them, locked off

steps: @Leo rolls over the wet rim onto the moonlit ledge, soaked and panting, as @Mia drops to her knees beside him, already shouting fast.
@Mia keeps shouting through tears, pressing her fist hard against the middle of @Leo's chest.
@Mia presses her fist against his chest again as she goes on, tears running down her freckled cheeks.
@Mia's fist opens and she takes hold of the front of his torn jacket with both hands as she keeps talking.
@Mia keeps talking, her voice cracking, clutching his jacket, her face close to his in the torchlight.
@Mia lowers her voice as she goes on, her green eyes locked on his, her chin trembling.
@Mia says the last words in a broken whisper, her hands still knotted in his jacket.
@Mia closes her mouth, breathing raggedly, as @Leo props himself up on one elbow and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly and quietly, water dripping from his beard, his grey-blue eyes steady on hers.
@Leo lays his blistered hand over both of hers on his jacket as he goes on, his voice low and honest.
@Leo shakes his head slowly as he keeps speaking, his thumb moving gently over her knuckles.
@Leo says the last words softly and closes his mouth, holding her hands against his chest.
@Mia lets out a shaky breath, mouth closed, and rests her forehead against his, her eyes shut.
@Mia and @Leo kneel forehead to forehead on the ledge, both silent, his hand over hers, the torchlight flickering on them.
Behind them a small child wrapped in furs sleeps against the rock in soft focus, while @Mia and @Leo stay forehead to forehead, silent.

scenes.title: Day Seven: The First Hands (Ngày 7: Những bàn tay đầu tiên)
scenes.location: Hang của bộ lạc buổi sáng sau lũ: nền hang phủ bùn và cành gãy, vệt nước còn in trên chân vách, nhưng vách đá giữa hang khô ráo dưới vệt nắng sớm chiếu qua cửa hang; măng đá hình voi ma mút, bếp lửa mới nhóm, một vỏ sò lớn đựng bột son đỏ, một ống sậy rỗng.
scenes.axis: Ở 19.1 máy quay đứng trên mỏm đá trước hang cao nhìn ra thung lũng: vách đá bên trái, mép mỏm đá và thung lũng phủ bùn phía dưới bên phải, đỉnh núi tuyết hồng ở xa, bộ lạc đứng dọc vách phía sau; từ 19.2 máy quay đứng trong hang lớn nhìn vào vách đá trơn giữa hang: vệt nắng sớm rọi xuống vách từ cửa hang bên trái, măng đá hình voi ma mút bên phải, bếp lửa mới nhóm ở tiền cảnh, Grandma Moon quỳ bên bếp.
scenes.props: Đôi tay phồng rộp của Leo, đai đeo ngực trống không còn camera, chuỗi vỏ sò và sừng lửa của Grandma Moon, vỏ sò lớn đựng bột son đỏ và hòn đá nghiền, ống sậy rỗng, vách đá khô giữa hang dưới vệt nắng sớm, hai dấu bàn tay đỏ mới in (một to, một nhỏ hơn ngay cạnh), bếp lửa mới nhóm, bùn và cành gãy trên nền hang, vệt nước trên chân vách.
scenes.setting: The large Ice Age clan cave the morning after the flood: mud and broken branches on the floor, a waterline stain along the lower walls, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, the bare dry rock wall in the middle lit by a shaft of early sunlight, a freshly lit hearth, a large shell holding red-ochre powder and a hollow reed tube.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: The water came, as you said. The fire lives. The people live. Not one of us is lost.
turns.tone: slow and solemn, quiet relief under every word

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Because your hunter believed us. And a boy who refused to let the fire die.
turns.tone: moved and humble, voice thick with feeling

clips.setting: Clear pink dawn after the flood, seen from the rock ledge high on the limestone cliff: the valley below covered in mud, stranded ice blocks and fallen trees, the river back in its bed, mist rising, snowy peaks glowing.

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

clips.extras: the clan, men, women and children in sewn hide tunics and fur cloaks covered from shoulders to knees, stands along the back of the rock ledge in soft focus, faces small and blurred, looking down at the valley
clips.sfx: a soft dawn wind over the cliff, water dripping from the rock, meltwater trickling far below in the valley, crows calling in the distance, furs rustling as people shift on the ledge

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot of @Moon standing at the edge of the rock ledge high on the cliff in the clear pink dawn, the clan in furs behind her in soft focus and the mud-covered valley below, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Moon's deeply lined face lit pink by the dawn as she turns from the valley, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Moon onto @Leo as she holds his blistered hands in hers, locked off
35mm medium two-shot of @Moon and @Leo hand in hand on the ledge, the clan in soft focus behind them and the snowy peaks glowing, slow push-in

steps: @Moon stands at the edge of the rock ledge high on the cliff, looking down at the mud-covered valley in the pink dawn, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly in her low husky voice, her pale eyes moving over the stranded ice blocks and fallen trees below.
Behind @Moon the clan in furs stands along the ledge in soft focus as she goes on, mist rising from the valley floor.
@Moon lifts her weathered hand toward the river running back in its bed as she keeps speaking, her white braid stirring in the breeze.
@Moon turns from the valley toward the people behind her and goes on slowly, the pink light warm on her lined face.
@Moon keeps talking, her voice heavy and calm, the red-ochre dot on her forehead catching the first sun.
@Moon turns to @Leo beside her and takes both of his blistered hands in hers as she keeps speaking.
@Moon says the last words slowly, turning his palms up to look at the blisters, then closes her mouth.
@Leo looks down at their joined hands, swallows and starts speaking at an even pace, his voice thick and low.
@Leo keeps talking, glancing back over his shoulder toward the clan in soft focus along the ledge, his eyes wet.
@Leo goes on, his grey-blue eyes returning to @Moon, his short sandy beard flecked with dried mud.
@Leo keeps speaking softly, his blistered fingers closing gently around her weathered hands.
@Leo's voice drops low and honest as he goes on, a tear running into his beard, the pink dawn on his face.
@Leo says the last words, closes his mouth and bows his head over their joined hands.
@Moon and @Leo stand hand in hand on the ledge, both mouths closed, as the clan behind them watches the sun rise over the peaks.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: From today, a new law. Whoever saves the clan leaves a hand on the stone. So the children's children remember.
turns.tone: slow and ceremonial, every word a law

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: On this wall, Grandmother? Right here, in the middle, where the light falls?
turns.tone: soft and wondering, a little breathless

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: the new hearth fire crackling, a smooth stone grinding powder in a shell, water dripping from the stained lower walls, boots squelching in mud on the cave floor, birdsong from the cave mouth

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Moon kneeling by the freshly lit hearth, grinding red-ochre powder in a large shell with a smooth stone, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Moon looking up at the bare rock wall in the shaft of early sunlight, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Moon onto @Mia holding the hollow reed tube, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Mia standing at the bare dry rock wall in the middle of the cave where the shaft of sunlight falls, @Moon kneeling by the hearth in the foreground, handheld follow

steps: @Moon kneels beside the freshly lit hearth, grinding red-ochre powder in a large shell with a smooth round stone, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, her weathered hand circling the stone through the bright red powder, her braid over one shoulder.
@Moon taps the stone on the rim of the shell as she goes on, a little red dust rising into the firelight.
@Moon lifts her pale eyes to the bare dry rock wall in the middle of the cave as she keeps speaking.
@Moon keeps speaking in her low husky voice, a shaft of early sunlight falling across the wall behind her, her jaw firm.
@Moon picks up the hollow reed tube from beside the shell and goes on slowly, turning it in her fingers.
@Moon holds the reed tube out toward @Mia as she keeps talking, weighing each word like a law.
@Moon says the last words slowly, red powder still on her fingertips, her pale eyes on @Mia.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, while @Mia, kneeling opposite her, takes the hollow reed tube in both hands.
@Mia looks from the tube to the wall and starts speaking at an even pace, her green eyes wide under the cream beanie.
@Mia rises and keeps talking, the reed tube in one hand, stepping over the mud and broken branches on the cave floor.
@Mia walks toward the bare rock wall in the middle of the cave as she goes on, glancing back at @Moon.
@Mia stops in the shaft of early sunlight and lays her free palm on the dry stone as she keeps asking, half turned toward the hearth.
@Mia asks the last question looking back over her shoulder at @Moon, then closes her mouth.
@Mia stands in the warm shaft of sunlight with her palm flat on the bare wall, mouth closed, while @Moon nods once by the hearth.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Mia, look at it. A big hand, and a smaller one right beside it. The same two we touched that night.
turns.tone: slow and hushed, stunned, almost a whisper

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: It's us. It was always us, Leo. For twenty-seven thousand years.
turns.tone: tearful and soft, quietly certain

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: a soft puff of breath through a hollow reed, fine powder pattering on stone, the hearth fire crackling, water dripping somewhere in the cave, birdsong at the cave mouth

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Leo and @Mia at the sunlit rock wall, their two hands pressed side by side on the stone while @Mia blows red-ochre powder through the hollow reed tube around them, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo in profile beside the wall, the two fresh red hand stencils sharp next to his face, slow rack focus from the stencils to his eyes
24mm wide shot of @Leo and @Mia standing before the big red hand and the smaller one in the shaft of early sunlight, the hearth glowing behind them, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia with tears welling, red powder on her fingers, locked off
50mm medium two-shot of @Leo and @Mia looking at each other in front of the two red hands, slow push-in

steps: @Mia blows a soft cloud of red-ochre powder through the hollow reed tube around their two hands pressed side by side, while @Leo is already speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking in a hushed voice as @Mia lowers the reed tube and the red dust settles on the sunlit stone.
@Leo and @Mia slowly lift their hands away from the wall together, and @Leo goes on talking, his voice catching.
On the wall a big red hand stencil and a slightly smaller one appear side by side, and @Leo stares at them, still speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking, his grey-blue eyes moving from the big red hand to the smaller one right beside it.
@Leo lifts his blistered hand and holds it just above the big red hand, matching it exactly, as he goes on.
@Leo keeps speaking slowly, standing with @Mia before the two red hands in the shaft of early sunlight.
@Leo turns his head toward @Mia as he goes on, his voice dropping low, red powder still on his fingers.
@Leo says the last words, closes his mouth and looks at @Mia, breathing slowly.
@Mia's eyes fill with tears as she starts speaking at an even pace, her voice catching, her gaze on the two red hands.
@Mia keeps talking, her red-dusted fingers curling at her side, her chin trembling.
@Mia turns from the wall to @Leo as she goes on, a tear sliding down her freckled cheek.
@Mia keeps speaking softly, a small wet laugh in her voice, her green eyes locked on his.
@Mia says the last words in a whisper and closes her mouth, while @Leo gazes back at her with his mouth closed.
@Leo and @Mia stand face to face before the big red hand and the smaller one, both silent, the sunlight on their faces.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I should have said this three years ago. I'm in love with you.
turns.tone: slow and trembling, completely sincere

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: I know. You're a terrible actor, Leo, when it really counts.
turns.tone: dry and teasing, smiling through tears

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Can I kiss you, or is that against cave law?
turns.tone: fast and shy, laughing under his breath

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: the hearth fire crackling, a soft breath of wind at the cave mouth, water dripping from the rock, and at the very end the clan cheering, whooping and clapping

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot of @Leo and @Mia facing each other before the two red hand stencils in the shaft of sunlight, @Leo holding her hand, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Leo, his eyes steady on hers, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo onto @Mia smiling through tears, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo with a shy lopsided grin, locked off

steps: @Leo takes @Mia's red-dusted hand in his blistered one before the two red hands on the wall and is already speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, his thumb moving over her knuckles, his grey-blue eyes steady on hers.
@Leo draws a deep breath and goes on, the shaft of early sunlight falling across both their faces.
@Leo keeps speaking, his voice dropping low and honest, his face open and serious.
@Leo says the last words very softly, his jaw trembling a little, still holding her hand.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, swallowing hard, while @Mia looks at him with her mouth closed.
@Mia's dry half-smile spreads slowly across her freckled face as she starts speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking, tilting her head at him, her green eyes shining with tears and amusement.
@Mia gives his hand a squeeze as she goes on, her teasing tone softening.
@Mia keeps talking with a small wet laugh, her free hand resting flat on @Leo's chest.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, smiling, as @Leo breaks into a lopsided grin and starts speaking fast.
@Leo keeps talking quickly, glancing sideways toward the hearth and back to her, his eyebrows raised.
@Leo leans a little closer as he goes on, his grin turning shy, his forehead almost touching hers.
@Leo asks the last words and closes his mouth, and @Mia, mouth closed, gives one small nod.
@Mia and @Leo lean in and share one gentle, silent, closed-mouth kiss, then rest their foreheads together while the clan cheers behind them in soft focus.

scenes.title: Pebble's Seeing Stone (Hòn đá biết nhìn của Pebble)
scenes.location: Bãi cỏ khô ven sông dưới hang buổi trưa sau lũ: nắng vàng ấm, nước sông đã trong lại, bùn khô nứt nẻ, một hình nộm tuần lộc bện bằng cỏ khô dựng làm bia tập ném.
scenes.axis: Ở 20.1–20.2 máy quay đứng trên bãi cỏ khô ven sông nhìn ngang: dòng sông trong chảy từ trái sang phải ở hậu cảnh, hình nộm tuần lộc bện cỏ ở bên phải xa, vách đá có hang của bộ lạc phía trên bên trái; ở 20.3 máy quay trong hang nhìn thẳng vào vách có hai bàn tay đỏ, bếp lửa ở tiền cảnh bên trái; ở 20.4 máy quay đứng trong hang nhìn ra cửa hang, Grandma Moon bên trái, Mia bên phải, núi tuyết và mây giông ở xa phía sau.
scenes.props: Hòn đá xám dẹt có lỗ xâu dây da trên ngực Pebble, bộ khoan cung (cung, que khoan, đế gỗ, bùi nhùi), khói mỏng, ống phóng giáo bằng gỗ và một ngọn giáo dài mũi đá lửa, gậy gỗ và nẹp chân buộc khăn đỏ của Roar, hình nộm tuần lộc bện cỏ khô, que than vẽ, hai bàn tay đỏ son trên vách, chuỗi vỏ sò biển của Grandma Moon, mây giông và chớp không tiếng ở xa.
scenes.setting: A dry grassy riverbank below the clan cave at midday after the flood: warm golden sunshine, the river running clear again, cracked dry mud, a reindeer-shaped target woven from dry grass standing on the bank.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Hello everyone! Today I show you how to make fire with a bow! I can survive anywhere!
turns.tone: a bright TV-host imitation, fast and proud

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Hey, that's my line! You stole my whole show. And honestly, you do it better.
turns.tone: laughing, warm and amazed

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Pebble: a small knee-length tunic of sewn hide with a fur hood covering both shoulders, hide leggings, a string of pierced snail shells around one wrist, a flat grey stone with a hole hanging on a leather cord on his chest, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: a bow drill whirring and squeaking on wood, a clear river running over stones, warm wind in dry grass, a small boy panting, a man laughing

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Pebble kneeling by a bow drill on the dry grassy riverbank, holding up the flat grey stone on his chest toward his face like a camera, handheld
85mm close-up of @Pebble talking down at the stone on his chest while his arm saws the bow below frame, locked off

steps: On the sunny riverbank @Pebble kneels by a bow drill, holds the flat grey stone on his chest up toward his face and is already talking fast.
@Pebble keeps talking quickly into the stone with a huge showman's grin, one small arm flung wide like a TV host.
@Pebble lets the stone drop back on its cord and saws the bow back and forth as he keeps talking, one fur-wrapped foot on the board.
@Pebble keeps sawing the bow fast as he goes on, a thin thread of grey smoke curling up from the spindle.
@Pebble glances down at the stone on his chest as if into a lens and keeps talking, his eyebrows bouncing.
@Pebble shouts the last words, puffing out his small chest, then closes his mouth with a proud nod.
@Leo, crouching beside him, bursts out laughing and starts speaking, pointing at the stone on @Pebble's chest.
@Leo keeps talking through his laughter, patting his own empty chest harness in mock outrage.
@Leo shakes his head and goes on, wiping a laughing tear from his eye with the back of his blistered hand.
@Leo keeps talking, ruffling @Pebble's messy mop of brown hair with one hand, his grin wide.
@Leo leans in toward @Pebble as he says the last words, his voice dropping into honest admiration.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, still grinning, while @Pebble beams up at him with his mouth closed.
@Pebble bends back over the bow drill, mouth closed, sawing hard, and a thicker curl of grey smoke rises.
@Leo leans close to watch the smoke with his lips pressed together, while @Pebble keeps sawing in silence.
@Pebble and @Leo crouch over the smoking bow drill on the sunny riverbank, both silent, the woven-grass reindeer target standing behind them.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Like this, brother. The thrower is a longer arm. Let your whole body throw, not just your hand.
turns.tone: gruff and patient, a teacher for once

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I hit it! I actually hit it! Did you see that? First try!
turns.tone: fast and ecstatic, almost squeaking

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Now you are a hunter.
turns.tone: slow and proud, deep and warm

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Roar: a long-sleeved tunic of dark reindeer hide that fully covers his chest, fur-lined hide trousers, a necklace of animal teeth, a wooden spear-thrower at his belt, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: a spear whooshing through the air and a dry thud into woven grass, a clear river running over stones, warm wind in the grass, a man whooping, a wooden staff creaking

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Roar leaning on his wooden staff with his splinted ankle, placing the wooden spear-thrower in @Leo's hand on the sunny riverbank, handheld
85mm close-up of @Roar's weathered face, his eyes on the grass target down the bank, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Leo swinging his whole body forward as the spear flies from the thrower into the woven-grass reindeer target, @Roar watching on his staff, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Leo jumping with both arms in the air, handheld
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo onto @Roar nodding, his big hand on @Leo's shoulder, locked off

steps: @Roar leans on his wooden staff, his splinted ankle bound with the red bandana, and is already speaking as he places the spear-thrower in @Leo's hand.
@Roar keeps talking in his deep rough voice, closing @Leo's blistered fingers around the hooked end of the wooden thrower.
@Roar fits the butt of a long flint-tipped spear into the hook of the thrower as he goes on, gruff and patient.
@Roar stretches his own arm out long beside @Leo's as he keeps talking, showing how the thrower adds reach.
@Roar turns @Leo's hips side-on to the target with his free hand as he goes on, his heavy brows low.
@Roar nods toward the woven-grass reindeer target down the bank and keeps talking, his jaw set.
@Leo swings his whole body forward and the spear flies from the thrower across the grass, as @Roar says the last words.
The spear sinks into the woven-grass target with a dry thud as @Roar closes his mouth and @Leo starts shouting fast.
@Leo jumps straight up with both arms in the air, shouting fast, his reindeer-hide cape flapping.
@Leo keeps shouting, pointing wildly at the spear standing in the grass target, his grin enormous.
@Leo spins toward @Roar as he goes on, bouncing on his toes, both fists clenched by his chest.
@Leo shouts the last words breathlessly and closes his mouth, panting, his eyes shining at @Roar.
@Roar limps one step closer on his staff and starts speaking slowly, his heavy brows lifting in approval.
@Roar keeps speaking as he claps one big hand down on @Leo's shoulder, nodding once.
@Roar says the last words and closes his mouth, his hand still on @Leo's shoulder, while @Leo stands tall with his mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: I draw you two holding hands. And the seeing stone on Fire's chest, so it is not lost forever.
turns.tone: careful and earnest, concentrating

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: It's perfect. Now we'll never be lost. Not even in twenty-seven thousand years.
turns.tone: slow and tender, close to tears

clips.setting: Inside the large Ice Age clan cave on the seventh day: the mammoth-shaped stalagmite and, in the middle of the rock wall, two fresh red-ochre hand stencils side by side, a big hand and a slightly smaller hand, with bare rock around them; a hearth fire burning.

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt
wardrobe.@Pebble: a small knee-length tunic of sewn hide with a fur hood covering both shoulders, hide leggings, a string of pierced snail shells around one wrist, a flat grey stone with a hole hanging on a leather cord on his chest, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: charcoal scratching on rock, the hearth fire crackling, a small boy breathing through his nose as he concentrates, soft wind at the cave mouth

85mm close-up of @Pebble in profile against the wall, his charcoal moving beside his face, locked off
35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Pebble onto @Mia kneeling beside him, locked off

steps: @Pebble kneels at the rock wall beside the two red hand stencils, draws a stick of charcoal down the bare stone and is already talking.
@Pebble keeps talking as he draws a round head and a straight body, a first stick figure next to the big red hand.
@Pebble glances at @Mia kneeling beside him and goes on, drawing a second, smaller stick figure beside the first.
@Pebble joins the two stick figures with one short line between their arms, holding hands, as he keeps talking.
@Pebble keeps talking, his brow knotted in concentration, and draws a small square box on the bigger figure's chest.
@Pebble taps the little square box twice with the charcoal as he goes on, his big dark eyes serious.
@Pebble presses one hand to the flat grey stone on his own chest as he keeps talking, his voice dropping.
@Pebble says the last words and closes his mouth, while @Mia lays her hand on his small shoulder and starts speaking slowly.
@Mia keeps talking slowly, her eyes welling as she looks from the drawing to the boy, her voice soft.
@Mia smooths a smudge of charcoal from @Pebble's cheek with her thumb as she goes on, a tear on her lashes.
@Mia keeps speaking softly, gazing at the two stick figures holding hands beside the two red hands.
@Mia's lips tremble into a smile as she goes on, her hand still resting on @Pebble's shoulder.
@Mia keeps talking slowly as a tear rolls down her freckled cheek, her other hand touching the bare rock beside the drawing.
@Mia says the last words in a whisper and closes her mouth, pulling @Pebble gently against her side.
@Mia and @Pebble kneel together before the two red hands and the new charcoal drawing, both silent, the hearth fire flickering on the wall.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Shells from the far salt water, from grandmother to grandmother. Now they are yours, Spark. Thunder is coming.
turns.tone: slow and grave, a gift and a warning

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: The thunder that brought us here. Grandmother, is it coming to take us back?
turns.tone: quiet and uneasy, searching the sky

clips.setting: Late afternoon at the mouth of the Ice Age clan cave: black storm clouds rolling over the snowy peaks, silent lightning in the distance, wind in the pines, warm firelight behind, and on the inner wall two red-ochre hand stencils.

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a small red first-aid pouch on her belt

clips.sfx: wind rising in the pines, pierced shells clicking together, the hearth fire crackling behind them, gusts moaning across the cave mouth

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Moon and @Mia facing each other at the mouth of the cave, black storm clouds rolling over the snowy peaks beyond them, @Moon lifting her shell necklace over her braid, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Moon holding the necklace of pierced sea shells up between them, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Moon onto @Mia as the shells settle on her collar, locked off
