steps: At the mouth of the cave @Moon lifts the necklace of pierced sea shells from around her own neck and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, drawing the string of shells up over her thick white braid with both weathered hands.
@Moon holds the necklace up between them as she goes on, the pale shells clicking softly in the wind.
@Moon keeps speaking, turning one shell between her fingers, her pale eyes fixed on @Mia.
@Moon reaches up and lowers the necklace over @Mia's cream beanie onto her shoulders as she goes on.
@Moon settles the shells on @Mia's collar with both hands and keeps talking in her low husky voice.
@Moon lifts her chin toward the black clouds rolling over the snowy peaks as she keeps speaking, her face grave.
@Moon says the last words slowly as silent lightning flickers far beyond the peaks, then closes her mouth.
@Mia touches the shells at her collar with trembling fingers and starts speaking at an even pace, her eyes on @Moon.
@Mia keeps talking, closing her hand around the shells, her green eyes shining.
@Mia turns her head toward the dark sky beyond the cave mouth as she goes on, her voice quieter.
@Mia keeps speaking as a silent white flash of distant lightning lights her freckled face for an instant.
@Mia looks back at @Moon and asks the last words, her fingers tight around the shells.
@Mia finishes asking and closes her mouth, while @Moon looks out at the storm with her lips pressed together.
@Moon and @Mia stand silent at the cave mouth as black clouds roll over the peaks and lightning flickers soundlessly far away.

scenes.title: Storm on the Seventh Evening (Giông chiều thứ bảy)
scenes.location: Hang của bộ lạc trong đêm giông: ngoài cửa hang mưa như trút, chớp trắng loá liên hồi; măng đá hình voi ma mút, bếp lửa cháy đỏ; giữa vách đá là hai bàn tay đỏ son, một to, một nhỏ, bên cạnh là hình vẽ than hai người que nắm tay nhau.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng trong hang, lưng quay về bếp lửa, nhìn thẳng vào vách đá giữa hang: hai bàn tay đỏ và hình vẽ than hai người que ở giữa vách, cửa hang rộng với mưa và chớp trắng ở bên trái, măng đá hình voi ma mút bên phải, bộ lạc đứng lùi trong bóng tối phía sau bếp lửa.
scenes.props: Hai bàn tay đỏ son trên vách ấm sáng mờ mỗi lần chớp và rực lên ở 21.4, hình vẽ than hai người que nắm tay, chuỗi vỏ sò biển trên cổ Mia, gậy gỗ và nẹp chân buộc khăn đỏ của Roar, vòng răng thú của Roar, hòn đá xám dẹt có lỗ trên ngực Pebble, đai đeo ngực trống của Leo, bếp lửa đỏ, mưa trút ngoài cửa hang.
scenes.setting: A storm at night inside the large Ice Age clan cave: white lightning flashing through the wide mouth onto the rock wall with two red-ochre hand stencils side by side and, beside them, a charcoal drawing of two stick figures holding hands, the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, a hearth fire, the clan standing back in the shadows.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Feel it. The hands are getting warm. It's calling us home. Leo, do we stay, or do we go?
turns.tone: slow and trembling, full of wonder and dread

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Together, or not at all. Whatever you choose, Mia, I choose it with you.
turns.tone: even and certain, warm and sure

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a necklace of pierced sea shells

clips.sfx: heavy rain pouring outside the cave mouth, thunder rolling overhead, the hearth fire hissing in gusts of wind, a low warm hum from the rock wall

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo standing before the rock wall in the storm night, the two red hand stencils glowing faintly warm as white lightning flashes through the cave mouth, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia holding her palm just above the glowing smaller red hand, lightning flickering on her face, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Mia onto @Leo, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Mia and @Leo hand in hand before the faintly glowing red hands, the clan standing back in the shadows by the hearth, a lightning flash filling the cave mouth, locked off

steps: @Mia stands before the rock wall in the storm night, a white flash lighting the two red hands, and is already speaking slowly, her breath shaky.
@Mia keeps talking slowly as the two red hand stencils give off a faint warm glow with the lightning.
@Mia lifts her palm and holds it just above the smaller red hand as she goes on, her fingers trembling.
@Mia keeps speaking, feeling the warmth on her skin, her green eyes wide in the flickering white light.
@Mia draws her hand back a little and goes on, the sea shells at her collar rising and falling with her breath.
@Mia turns from the glowing wall to @Leo as she keeps talking, rain hammering beyond the cave mouth.
@Mia looks searchingly into his face as she goes on, her voice catching on the question.
@Mia asks the last words slowly and closes her mouth, her lips pressed together, waiting.
@Leo takes her trembling hand in his blistered one and starts speaking at an even pace, his eyes steady.
@Leo keeps talking, lacing his fingers through hers as another flash makes the red hands glow behind them.
@Leo steps closer as he goes on, his voice low and sure, a gust from the cave mouth tugging at his cape.
@Leo keeps speaking, lifting their joined hands slightly between them, his grey-blue eyes on hers.
@Leo says the last words with a small firm nod, his thumb pressing her knuckles.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and @Mia, mouth closed, lets out a long shaky breath.
@Mia and @Leo stand hand in hand before the faintly glowing red hands, both silent, as white lightning flashes through the cave mouth.

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Go with the thunder, brother. Tell your people that a hunter of this cave called you brother.
turns.tone: slow and rough, gruff pride hiding tears

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: And tell your children about the strangers who pulled you out of a hole, big man.
turns.tone: teasing and warm, voice wobbling

wardrobe.@Leo: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a torn mud-stained red softshell jacket, muddy olive-green cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

clips.sfx: rain pouring beyond the cave mouth, thunder rumbling, the hearth fire crackling, a wooden staff knocking on stone, two heavy thumps on hide-covered backs

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Roar limping up to @Leo on his wooden staff, his splinted ankle bound with the red bandana, lightning flashing through the cave mouth behind them, handheld
85mm close-up of @Roar's weathered face lit by firelight and lightning, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Roar onto @Leo grinning with wet eyes, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Roar and @Leo hugging and thumping each other's backs in front of the glowing red hands, the hearth fire and the storm-lit cave mouth around them, locked off

steps: @Roar limps up to @Leo on his wooden staff in the storm-lit cave, his splinted ankle bound with the red bandana, and is already speaking slowly.
@Roar keeps talking in his deep rough voice, planting the staff and straightening his broad shoulders in front of @Leo.
@Roar lays his heavy hand on @Leo's shoulder as he goes on, his thick brows drawn together.
@Roar keeps speaking slowly, a white flash from the cave mouth lighting his necklace of animal teeth.
@Roar looks hard into @Leo's eyes as he goes on, his fierce jaw working beneath his short dark beard.
@Roar holds out his thick forearm as he keeps talking, his voice dropping lower.
@Roar and @Leo clasp each other's forearms tight as @Roar says the last words, his eyes glistening in the firelight.
@Roar finishes and closes his mouth, swallowing, as @Leo squeezes his forearm and starts speaking with a wobbly grin.
@Leo keeps talking with a crooked grin, his grey-blue eyes wet, still holding @Roar's forearm.
@Leo nods down at @Roar's splinted ankle as he goes on, the red bandana bright in the firelight.
@Leo keeps talking, miming a heave on a rope with his free hand, his grin widening.
@Leo keeps talking, poking a teasing finger at @Roar's broad chest, his voice cracking.
@Leo says the last words as @Roar pulls him into a hard hug and they thump each other's backs.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, his chin on @Roar's shoulder, the two men thumping each other's backs again.
@Roar steps back holding @Leo by the shoulders, his fierce face breaking into his first wide smile, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Spark, when you go back to the tiny people in the stone, say hello everyone for me!
turns.tone: fast and wobbly, trying not to cry

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: I promise, Pebble. And you keep the fire alive, little one. Every single night, okay?
turns.tone: slow and gentle, a quiet promise

wardrobe.@Mia: a reindeer-hide cape with a grey fur collar over a dusty teal down jacket, black hiking trousers, grey hiking boots, a cream knit beanie, a necklace of pierced sea shells
wardrobe.@Pebble: a small knee-length tunic of sewn hide with a fur hood covering both shoulders, hide leggings, a string of pierced snail shells around one wrist, a flat grey stone with a hole hanging on a leather cord on his chest, fur-wrapped feet

clips.sfx: rain pouring beyond the cave mouth, a long roll of thunder, the hearth fire crackling, a small boy sniffling, soft fur rustling in a hug

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Pebble hugging @Mia around the waist and looking up at her, the flat grey stone on his chest, lightning flashing at the cave mouth, handheld
85mm close-up of @Pebble's tear-streaked face tilted up at her, locked off
50mm medium shot of @Mia kneeling down to @Pebble's height and brushing his messy hair back, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia speaking softly, her forehead near his, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Mia hugging @Pebble tight before the glowing red hands and the charcoal drawing, the hearth fire and the storm-lit cave mouth around them, locked off

steps: @Pebble hugs @Mia tight around the waist in the storm-lit cave, tilts his face up at her and is already talking fast, his lip wobbling.
@Pebble keeps talking quickly, tears welling in his big dark eyes, the flat grey stone swinging on his chest.
@Pebble lets go with one hand and taps the stone on his chest as he goes on, sniffing hard.
@Pebble keeps talking fast, his round cheeks wet and pink, his chin trembling in the firelight.
@Pebble says the last words in a wobbly high voice, a white flash from the cave mouth lighting his face.
@Pebble finishes and closes his mouth, his lips pressed into a pout, as @Mia sinks to her knees in front of him.
@Mia kneels at @Pebble's height, brushes the messy hair from his eyes and starts speaking slowly.
@Mia keeps talking slowly and softly, cupping his wet cheek in her hand, her own eyes glistening.
@Mia taps the flat grey stone on his chest with one finger as she goes on, a small smile on her lips.
@Mia keeps speaking softly, nodding toward the hearth fire glowing behind him, her voice warm.
@Mia rests her forehead against @Pebble's as she goes on, her braid falling over her shoulder.
@Mia says the last words in a whisper and closes her mouth, her forehead still against his.
@Mia pulls @Pebble into a tight hug, both mouths closed, his small arms wrapping around her neck.
@Pebble presses his face into the fur collar of her cape, mouth closed, as @Mia rocks him gently.
@Mia holds @Pebble tight before the faintly glowing red hands, both silent, while white lightning flashes beyond the cave mouth.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: You were right about the willow trap. Easy to swim in. Impossible to find the way out.
turns.tone: dry and soft, a wistful smile in it

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Unless we swim out together. Hold my hand, and don't let go, no matter what.
turns.tone: slow, low and certain, a vow

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Never. I promise.
turns.tone: fast and breathless, a whispered vow

scenes.title: Return (Trở về)
scenes.time_label: Rạng sáng, hang Bàn Tay ngày nay (21:00–22:00)
scenes.location: Hang đá vôi ở Pyrenees ngày nay lúc rạng sáng sau giông: cửa hang vòm, măng đá hình voi ma mút, hàng trăm dấu bàn tay đỏ son đã mờ trên vách, giữa vách là một bàn tay to và một bàn tay nhỏ hơn ngay cạnh; ánh đèn pin của đội cứu hộ quét vào từ cửa hang.
scenes.axis: Ở 22.1–22.2 máy quay đứng trên nền hang nhìn về phía cửa hang vòm: Leo và Mia nằm rồi ngồi dưới chân vách bàn tay ở bên phải, cửa hang với rừng thu và chùm đèn pin của đội cứu hộ ở bên trái; ở 22.3–22.4 máy quay đặt sát cửa hang nhìn ra thung lũng mùa thu, vách hang ở phía sau lưng nhân vật, đường cáp treo xa xa bên phải.
scenes.props: Vách hàng trăm dấu bàn tay đỏ đã mờ, bàn tay to và bàn tay nhỏ ở giữa vách, chùm đèn pin trong bụi sáng, dây cứu hộ trên nền hang, áo phản quang và mũ bảo hộ của nhân viên cứu hộ, cáng cứu thương và chăn cứu hộ bạc, chuỗi vỏ sò trên cổ Mia, đai đeo ngực trống của Leo, đôi tay phồng rộp chai sạn của Leo, chiếc gimbal của Mia nằm trên nền hang (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), đường cáp treo xa xa.
scenes.setting: Early morning inside the same large limestone cave in the Pyrenees today after the storm: the mammoth-shaped stalagmite, the wall of hundreds of faded red-ochre hand stencils with one bigger hand in the middle and a slightly smaller hand right beside it, rescue ropes on the floor, flashlight beams in the dusty air, autumn forest beyond the mouth.

steps: @Leo lies on the dusty cave floor beside @Mia, their hands still joined, opens his eyes and is already whispering, flashlight beams sweeping overhead.
@Leo lifts his head toward the arched cave mouth as he keeps whispering, beams of light crossing the dusty air.
@Leo squeezes @Mia's hand and gently shakes her shoulder as he goes on whispering, his eyes wide.
@Leo rolls onto his side toward her and keeps whispering, a flashlight beam passing across his bearded face.
@Leo points toward the moving beams at the cave mouth as he goes on, a grin breaking through his whisper.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth as @Mia's green eyes flutter open, her hand still in his.
@Mia pushes herself up to sit on the cave floor and starts speaking at an even pace, blinking at the light.
@Mia keeps talking, the necklace of pierced sea shells swinging at her collar as she turns toward the wall.
@Mia lifts her eyes to the wall of faded hand stencils as she goes on, her lips parting in wonder.
@Mia keeps talking, gazing at the big faded red hand and the smaller one beside it in the middle of the wall.
@Mia points up at the two old hands as she goes on, her voice dropping low, her finger trembling.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, and @Leo, sitting up beside her, glances at their joined hands and starts speaking fast.
@Leo keeps talking fast with a crooked grin, lifting their joined hands a little between them.
@Leo says the last words, closes his mouth and grins at her, his thumb moving over her knuckles.
@Mia and @Leo sit hand in hand beneath the wall of faded hand stencils, both silent, as flashlight beams sweep closer through the dust.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Excuse me, how long were we missing? Just one night?

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Seven fingers. Seven days. Seven suns. It all really happened, Leo.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: And I don't have one single second of footage to prove it.
turns.tone: rueful and amused, laughing at himself

steps: @Leo sits up on the dusty cave floor, turns to a rescuer in a yellow high-visibility jacket kneeling beside him and is already asking fast.

@Mia lifts her hand to the necklace of pierced sea shells at her collar as she goes on, her voice soft.

@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, smiling, as @Leo looks down at his chest and starts speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking, patting the empty black chest harness with both hands, its clip hanging open.
@Leo turns the empty clip of the harness over in his blistered fingers as he goes on, shaking his head.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Look. We have this. Grandmother's shells, from the far salt water. And your hands, Leo. Those hands make fire now.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: And I've got you. That's better footage than anything I ever shot.

steps: @Mia sits beside @Leo on a rescue stretcher at the sunlit cave mouth, a silver rescue blanket over her shoulders, and is already speaking slowly.

@Mia keeps speaking, holding the shells out toward @Leo, a little grit still caught in their holes.

@Mia keeps speaking slowly, looking up from his rough palm into his eyes, her voice dropping.
@Mia lays her own hand flat in his open palm as she says the last words, smiling.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, her hand resting in his, as @Leo looks at her and starts speaking.
@Leo keeps talking at an even pace, closing his blistered fingers gently around her hand.
@Leo shakes his head slowly as he goes on, a small smile on his bearded face, his eyes never leaving hers.
@Leo keeps speaking, glancing for a second at the empty clip on his chest harness, then back at her.
@Leo says the last words softly with a crooked grin, lifting her hand to his chest.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and @Mia leans her head on his shoulder, mouth closed.
@Mia and @Leo sit silent on the stretcher at the cave mouth, hand in hand under the silver blankets, the autumn valley glowing below.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: No more fake survival. No more scripts. I'm going to tell everyone the truth. All of it.
turns.tone: firm and resolved, plain and honest

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then I'm not quitting. Somebody has to film you being honest. For once in your life.
turns.tone: dry and teasing, smiling

scenes.time_label: Một tuần sau, hiên nhà gỗ (22:00–23:00)
scenes.location: Hiên nhà gỗ chalet ở chân núi Pyrenees ngày nay, chiều thu: lá vàng, núi xa, một bếp lửa nhỏ trong vòng đá trên sân, chiếc điện thoại gắn trên chân máy ba chân quay về phía hiên.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng trên bãi cỏ nhìn về phía hiên nhà gỗ: bậc hiên ở giữa, vòng đá có bếp lửa nhỏ ở tiền cảnh bên trái, điện thoại trên chân máy nhỏ ở tiền cảnh bên phải quay về phía bậc hiên, rặng núi đá rực nắng chiều ở xa phía sau bên trái; ở 23.3–23.4 hai người ngồi sát nhau bên bếp lửa, hiên nhà ở phía sau.
scenes.props: Điện thoại gắn trên chân máy ba chân nhỏ (màn hình chỉ phát sáng, không chữ), bậc hiên gỗ cũ, lá vàng, vòng đá có bếp lửa nhỏ, bộ khoan cung tự làm (cung, que khoan, đế gỗ, bùi nhùi khô), đốm than đỏ, phong bì gấp đôi trơn không chữ của Mia, chiếc bật lửa nhỏ, chuỗi vỏ sò trên cổ Mia, đôi tay chai sạn của Leo.
scenes.setting: The wooden porch of a mountain chalet at the forest edge in the Pyrenees today, autumn evening at golden dusk: worn plank steps, golden leaves, a small fire in a stone ring on the lawn, a smartphone on a small tripod, rocky peaks glowing in the distance.

85mm close-up of @Mia holding up a small lighter with a sly grin, locked off

steps: @Mia pulls a plain folded envelope from the back pocket of her jeans, holds it up between two fingers and is already speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking, waving the plain envelope gently in front of @Leo's face, one eyebrow raised.
@Mia taps the folded envelope against his knee as she goes on, her dry half-smile daring him.
@Mia asks the last words and closes her mouth, holding the envelope out to @Leo.
@Leo takes the folded envelope from her fingers, looks her in the eye and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, holding the envelope up between them in both hands, his face calm and serious.
@Leo tears the envelope cleanly in two as he goes on, his eyes never leaving hers.
@Leo keeps speaking, holding the two torn halves over the small fire in the stone ring, his voice low.
@Leo lets the two halves drop into the flames as he goes on, the paper curling and catching at once.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, watching the torn paper blacken in the fire, a small smile tugging at his mouth.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and @Mia pulls a small lighter from her jeans pocket and starts speaking fast.
@Mia keeps talking quickly, holding up the small lighter between two fingers, a sly grin on her face.
@Mia turns the lighter in her fingers as she goes on, her eyes sparkling in the firelight.
@Mia says the last words with a slow wink at @Leo and closes her mouth.
@Mia and @Leo burst into silent laughter by the small fire, shoulders shaking, the torn envelope curling to ash in the flames.

scenes.title: Fire-Makers (Những người giữ lửa)
scenes.time_label: Ban ngày, hang Bàn Tay ngày nay (23:00–24:00)
scenes.location: Hang đá vôi ở Pyrenees ngày nay, ban ngày, trời quang: nắng chiếu qua cửa hang vòm, măng đá hình voi ma mút, hàng trăm bàn tay đỏ son mờ trên vách; ngay cạnh bàn tay to và bàn tay nhỏ ở giữa vách là hai hình người que vẽ than đã mờ, nắm tay nhau, một người có ô vuông trên ngực.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đứng giữa hang nhìn vào vách đá: vách hàng trăm bàn tay đỏ mờ ở giữa khung, bàn tay to và bàn tay nhỏ ở trung tâm, hình vẽ than hai người que ngay bên phải hai bàn tay, cửa hang vòm đầy nắng ở bên trái, măng đá hình voi ma mút bên phải; ở 24.4 cắt xen cùng hướng nhìn giữa hang ban ngày hôm nay và hang ban đêm thời băng hà với bếp lửa ở tiền cảnh.
scenes.props: Đèn pin của Mia, vách bàn tay đỏ mờ, hình vẽ than đã mờ hai người que nắm tay (một người có ô vuông trên ngực), chuỗi vỏ sò trên cổ Mia, điện thoại của Mia và của Leo (màn hình chỉ phát sáng); thời băng hà ở 24.4: hòn đá xám dẹt có lỗ trên ngực Pebble, bộ khoan cung, bếp lửa, hai bàn tay đỏ son còn tươi.
scenes.setting: Daytime inside the same large limestone cave in the Pyrenees today: sunlight slanting through the wide arched mouth onto the mammoth-shaped stalagmite and the wall of hundreds of faded red-ochre hand stencils, the bigger hand in the middle with a smaller hand beside it, and next to them a faint old charcoal drawing of two stick figures holding hands, one with a small square box on its chest.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Leo. Next to our hands. Two little stick figures, holding hands. One with a box on his chest.
turns.tone: a slow awed whisper

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: The seeing stone. Pebble drew us. Twenty-seven thousand years, and he kept us together.
turns.tone: moved, voice rough with tears

wardrobe.@Leo: a plain navy knit sweater, dark jeans, brown hiking boots
wardrobe.@Mia: a cream cable-knit sweater, dark jeans, grey hiking boots, a necklace of pierced sea shells

clips.sfx: soft footsteps echoing on the cave floor, water dripping, birdsong drifting in from the sunlit mouth, the faint click of a flashlight, a man's breath catching

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of @Mia shining a flashlight on the wall beside the two faded red hands in the middle, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Mia in profile, her flashlight beam on the faint charcoal drawing of two stick figures holding hands on the rock beside her face, slow rack focus
35mm medium two-shot of @Leo stepping up beside @Mia at the wall, staring at the drawing, handheld
85mm close-up of @Leo with wet eyes, the flashlight beam lighting his face from below, locked off
100mm extreme close-up of @Leo's fingertip barely touching the faint charcoal line of the stick figure with the small square box on its chest, the faded red hands beside it, locked off

steps: @Mia stands at the wall of faded hand stencils, sweeps her flashlight beam beside the two red hands in the middle and is already whispering slowly.
@Mia keeps whispering as her beam stops on a faint grey charcoal mark on the bare rock right next to the hands.
@Mia steps closer as she goes on, the beam tracing two faint stick figures standing side by side.
@Mia keeps talking softly, her light following a short charcoal line that joins the stick figures' hands.
@Mia's beam settles on a small square box drawn on the chest of the taller stick figure as she goes on.
@Mia keeps whispering, her free hand rising to the sea-shell necklace at her collar, her eyes wide.
@Mia turns her head toward @Leo as she goes on, her voice catching, the flashlight steady on the drawing.
@Mia says the last words in a whisper and closes her mouth, her lips trembling.
@Leo steps up beside @Mia, stares at the faint drawing and starts speaking at an even pace, his voice rough.
@Leo keeps talking, his grey-blue eyes moving from the little square box to the two red hands beside it.
@Leo lets out a short disbelieving laugh as he goes on, shaking his head slowly.
@Leo keeps talking, his eyes filling with tears, the flashlight beam lighting his face from below.
@Leo raises his hand toward the charcoal drawing as he says the last words, his voice breaking.
@Leo finishes and closes his mouth, and his fingertip barely touches the faint line of the figure with the square box.
@Leo's fingertip rests on the old charcoal line beside the faded red hands, mouth closed, while @Mia's beam holds steady on the drawing.

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Do you think he kept his promise? The fire alive, every single night?
turns.tone: soft and wondering, an even pace

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I know he did. That kid could survive anywhere. Better than I ever pretended to.
turns.tone: slow and fond, smiling

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then let's keep our promise too.
turns.tone: warm and decided

wardrobe.@Leo: a plain navy knit sweater, dark jeans, brown hiking boots
wardrobe.@Mia: a cream cable-knit sweater, dark jeans, grey hiking boots, a necklace of pierced sea shells

clips.sfx: water dripping in the quiet cave, birdsong from the sunlit mouth, the soft click of sea shells, a gentle breeze moving dry leaves at the entrance

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Mia and @Leo sitting on the cave floor shoulder to shoulder beneath the wall, looking up at the charcoal drawing, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Leo looking up at the drawing, a soft smile in his beard, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Mia onto @Leo, locked off
85mm close-up of @Mia, her fingers laced through @Leo's, her head tilting toward his shoulder, locked off

steps: @Mia sits on the cave floor shoulder to shoulder with @Leo beneath the wall, looks up at the charcoal drawing and is already speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking, turning a pale shell of her necklace between her fingers, her eyes on the two stick figures.
@Mia tilts her head back against the rock as she goes on, sunlight from the cave mouth falling across her knees.
@Mia keeps speaking softly, rubbing the shell with her thumb, her brow faintly creased.
@Mia keeps talking, turning to look at @Leo beside her, her voice quiet.
@Mia finishes and closes her mouth, and @Leo, looking up at the drawing, starts speaking slowly with a soft smile.
@Leo keeps talking slowly, his eyes on the little figure with the square box, a tender smile in his beard.
@Leo nods slowly as he goes on, his voice low and certain, his shoulder warm against hers.
@Leo keeps speaking, reaching down and taking @Mia's hand in his calloused one on the cave floor.
@Leo goes on with a small rueful laugh, shaking his head at himself, his thumb stroking her knuckles.
@Leo keeps talking softly, looking back up at the charcoal drawing, his eyes shining.
@Leo says the last words and closes his mouth, squeezing her hand, his gaze on the two stick figures.
@Mia lets the shell drop to her collar, laces her fingers through his and starts speaking at an even pace.
@Mia keeps talking, turning her face to @Leo with a quiet smile, her hand tight in his.
@Mia says the last words and closes her mouth, resting her head on @Leo's shoulder beneath the faded red hands.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Nothing. No lightning. Good. I'd like to stay in this century, here with you, if that's okay.
turns.tone: relieved and laughing, warm

turns.speaker: @Mia
turns.line: Then say it, Leo. You promised a little boy, remember?
turns.tone: fast and teasing, holding up the phone

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: Hello everyone. This one's from Pebble.
turns.tone: slow and simple, straight into the lens

wardrobe.@Leo: a plain navy knit sweater, dark jeans, brown hiking boots
wardrobe.@Mia: a cream cable-knit sweater, dark jeans, grey hiking boots, a necklace of pierced sea shells

clips.sfx: birdsong from the sunlit cave mouth, a soft breeze, water dripping, a man's relieved laugh echoing off the rock, the tiny chime of a phone starting to record

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of @Leo and @Mia standing at the wall, each pressing a palm on a faded red hand, sunlight through the cave mouth, slow push-in
85mm close-up of @Leo laughing with relief, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind @Leo onto @Mia raising her phone to film him, locked off
85mm close-up of @Leo looking straight into the lens of @Mia's phone, locked off
24mm wide shot of @Leo and @Mia at the sunlit wall of faded hand stencils, @Mia filming @Leo on her phone, locked off

steps: @Leo and @Mia press their palms onto the two faded red hands on the wall, and @Leo, eyes squeezed shut, is already speaking at an even pace.
@Leo keeps talking, opening one eye, then the other, his palm still flat on the big faded hand.
@Leo glances at the sunlit cave mouth as he goes on, the sky beyond bright, clear and still.
@Leo lets out a long breath of relief and keeps talking, a laugh bubbling into his voice.
@Leo lifts his hand from the wall and turns to @Mia as he goes on, grinning.
@Leo keeps talking with a soft grin, his eyes on hers, his calloused hand finding hers.
@Leo says the last words a little shyly and closes his mouth, his head tilted.
@Mia pulls her phone from the back pocket of her jeans, lifts it with its screen glowing and starts speaking fast.
@Mia keeps talking quickly, holding the phone up to film @Leo, its glow lighting her freckled face.
@Mia says the last words with a teasing nod toward the wall, then closes her mouth behind the phone.
@Leo straightens, looks straight into the lens of @Mia's phone and starts speaking slowly.
@Leo keeps talking slowly into the lens, no showman's grin, just a small honest smile.
@Leo says the last words softly, lifting one hand in a small wave toward the phone, then closes his mouth.
@Leo keeps his hand raised in the small wave, mouth closed, as @Mia keeps filming him.
@Mia lowers the phone a little and smiles at @Leo over it, both silent, the faded red hands lit by the sunlight behind them.

turns.speaker: @Leo
turns.line: I can't survive anywhere. Nobody can. I survived because she held my hand, and never let go.
turns.tone: slow and plain, a confession to the lens

turns.speaker: @Pebble
turns.line: Hello everyone! Today I teach you how to make fire with a bow! I can survive anywhere!
turns.tone: a bright proud TV-host shout

clips.setting: The same limestone cave with the mammoth-shaped stalagmite in two times: today in bright daylight with the wall of faded red hand stencils, and about twenty-seven thousand years ago at night, lit by a hearth fire with children of the clan sitting around it and two fresh red hand stencils on the wall.

wardrobe.@Leo: a plain navy knit sweater, dark jeans, brown hiking boots
wardrobe.@Pebble: a small knee-length tunic of sewn hide with a fur hood covering both shoulders, hide leggings, a string of pierced snail shells around one wrist, a flat grey stone with a hole hanging on a leather cord on his chest, fur-wrapped feet

clips.extras: only in the night-time shots long ago, a few small clan children in hide tunics with fur hoods, covered from shoulders to knees, sit around the hearth in soft focus; in the daytime shots only a woman's hand in a cream knit sleeve holds his hand at the edge of frame, her face never seen
clips.sfx: birdsong and a soft breeze in the sunlit cave, then a crackling hearth fire, a bow drill whirring, children gasping and clapping, a flame catching with a soft whoomp

85mm close-up of @Leo today in the sunlit cave, talking into the phone, the faded red hands soft behind him, locked off

85mm close-up of @Pebble long ago by the firelit hearth, shouting proudly as smoke curls up from his bow drill, locked off
50mm medium shot of the two red hand stencils on the rock wall, warm hearth firelight from long ago flickering over them and slowly fading to black, slow push-in

steps: Today in the sunlit cave @Leo holds a phone up at arm's length and is already speaking slowly, a woman's hand in a cream knit sleeve holding his.
@Leo keeps talking slowly into the phone, no grin, the faded red hand stencils soft on the wall behind him.
@Leo glances down at the woman's hand holding his as he goes on, his thumb moving over her knuckles.
@Leo keeps speaking, lifting their joined hands a little so the phone can see them, his voice low.
@Leo looks back into the phone as he goes on, his grey-blue eyes wet in the sunlight.
@Leo keeps speaking slowly, a small honest smile tugging at the corner of his mouth.
@Leo says the last words, tightening his hold on the woman's hand, his chin lifting.
In the same cave by night long ago, @Pebble kneels by the hearth with the flat grey stone on his chest and starts shouting fast, as @Leo's last words fade.
@Pebble saws the bow of a bow drill back and forth over a wooden board, still shouting, a few clan children in fur hoods watching around the hearth.
@Pebble keeps shouting proudly, lifting the flat grey stone on his chest toward his face like a TV host.
@Pebble grins at the children as he goes on, sawing faster, a thick curl of smoke rising from the spindle.
@Pebble keeps shouting, flinging one small arm wide as a glowing ember drops into the dry tinder.
@Pebble shouts the last words and closes his mouth as the tinder bursts into a bright flame and the children clap.
On the rock wall the two red hands, a big one and a smaller one, sit side by side in the flickering firelight of long ago, silent.
The firelight on the two red hands slowly fades, silent, until only their faint red outlines remain in the dark.
